items.n: From Malaga Caminito del Rey Guided Tour with transportation
items.d:
- On this trip, you will taken to the famous "Caminito del Rey", known as one of the most dangerous trails in the world! 
After reconstruction, which lasted four years, the "Caminito del Rey" reopened in 2015 and is now safe and accessible to all.
Walk down the walkway more than 100 meters above
- Cross the canyon on the suspension bridge
- Make a short stop in a typical small white Andalusian town

items.n: Dolphin Sightseeing Boat Tour from Benalmadena
items.d:
Take in the stunning views of the Alboran Sea and Costa del Sol. Don’t miss the chance to witness dolphins in their natural habitat and immerse yourself in nature! By choosing a catamaran with the Blue Flag, you’re supporting sustainable tourism that helps protect the marine environment. These boats also promote environmental education for our guests and ensure our activities have minimal impact on the ocean.

Our catamaran tour lasts around 2 hours, but the exact time may vary depending on where the dolphins are located. We may return to the port 10-15 minutes earlier or later based on the situation.

While we make every effort to spot dolphins on each trip, sightings cannot be guaranteed, as weather and sea conditions may affect their visibility. If we are unable to locate dolphins during your tour, we will offer you the option to reschedule at a 50% discount.

items.n: Kayak & Snorkel Tour in Cerro Gordo Natural Park, La Herradura
items.d:
Join our kayak and snorkeling tour for an unforgettable 2.5-hour adventure in the Natural Park “Los Acantilados de Maro-Cerro Gordo”.

Departing from our nautical area on La Herradura Beach, we paddle into one of the most beautiful protected coastal areas in Andalucía, famous for its dramatic cliffs, clear waters and rich marine life.

With respect for the environment, we may enter the magical Cueva de la Paloma, taking care not to touch or disturb the rocks, plants or wildlife.

Along the route, keep an eye out for mountain goats crossing the steep cliffs above the sea. This scenic route, mostly accessible only by water, offers a unique way to discover the natural park.

Unlike many tours, we take hygiene seriously: all masks, snorkels, fins, wetsuits and life jackets are thoroughly cleaned and disinfected between every use.

We’re also the only local tour providing full snorkel gear, including fins, for a more comfortable and complete snorkeling experience.

items.n: Malaga Wine and Tapas Small Group Guided Tour
items.d: Taste your way through Malaga on this 3.5-hour guided evening wine and tapas tour. See why Malaga has become one of Spain’s top dining destinations. Stroll the beautiful streets of Malaga, tasting some of the best local wines available. From Malaga sweet wines, to refreshing whites, fruity reds and even artisan vermouth, you will really get to experience our diverse wine growing regions. Bars, taverns and restaurants will make you feel welcome, offering such fare as Iberian cold cuts, fresh seafood and other local specialties.

items.n: Kayak and Snorkeling Excursion in Maro Cerro Gordo Cliffs
items.d: Don't miss the opportunity to make this an experience that will remain in your memory. Enjoy the beautiful natural landscapes that we have to offer. We are a company with more than 15 years of experience in this activity, our guides are professional, friendly and kind, we offer you a free drink (water), we also give you the photos that we we do it during the activity.

items.n: Caminito del Rey Day Trip from Costa del Sol
items.d:
Discover the Caminito del Rey with the comfort and security of an organized experience from the Costa del Sol. Our tour includes convenient transportation from Málaga and selected pickup points, allowing you to relax and enjoy the journey.

Travel in a comfortable coach while our professional guides share the fascinating history of the Caminito del Rey, once known as one of the most dangerous walkways in the world and now fully restored for a safe and unforgettable adventure.

During the 7.7 km route, you will walk along spectacular cliffside paths, cross hanging footbridges, and admire breathtaking views of the Gaitanes Gorge and the surrounding natural landscape.

Our experienced guides accompany you throughout the experience, providing interesting insights about the area and ensuring you enjoy this iconic Andalusian attraction safely and comfortably.

items.n: Discover Ronda and Setenil de las Bodegas in a Day from Málaga
items.d:
We’ll pick you up at your chosen meeting point for the perfect tour to discover the essence of Andalusia in a single day. Sierras, valleys, horses, bulls, white villages, and romance. Departing from Málaga, with no additional stops along the Costa del Sol.

First, explore the fascinating Ronda, with its spectacular Puente Nuevo spanning the Tajo Gorge and its historic old town full of charm and history. Then, head to the picturesque Setenil de las Bodegas, known for its unique houses built beneath giant rocks.

With free time to explore at your own pace, you’ll be able to stop at charming corners, savor local cuisine, and truly immerse yourself in the beauty and culture of these unique Andalusian destinations. Explore hidden streets, visit local shops, and take in the stunning views.

Create unforgettable memories while experiencing the magic of Ronda and Setenil, two of the most enchanting towns in Andalusia.

items.n: The Best of Malaga: Guided Tour of Cathedral, Alcazaba & Theatre
items.d:
Join 600+ travelers on Malaga’s top-rated tour! Discover 3,000 years of history with an official expert guide in one fun and complete experience.

What we visit:

* Roman Theatre: Step back to the 1st century.

* The Alcazaba: The "Small Alhambra" and stunning bay views.

* The Cathedral: Secrets and legends of "La Manquita."

Why choose us?

* Expert Storytellers: Legends and fun facts, never boring.

* Official Quality: Certified professional guides only.

* Top-Rated: 600+ verified 5-star reviews.

Book now for the most complete Malaga experience!

items.n: Morocco: Tangier Private Tour from Malaga & Tarifa, All Inclusive
items.d:
Discover an unforgettable day in Tangier, Morocco, guided by an experienced expert. Begin your journey with a delicious breakfast before boarding a scenic ferry, taking in panoramic views of Tangier’s colonial and international landscape. A visit to Cap Spartel is included, where the Atlantic meets the Mediterranean—ideal for capturing memorable photos on an Atlantic dune, with an optional camel ride available.

Explore the lively Medina souk and the charm of the Kasbah. Midway through your adventure, enjoy an authentic Moroccan lunch included in the tour. Continue with a stroll through bustling markets filled with dried fruits, vegetables, spices, and jewelry. End the day with tea or coffee at the historic Continental Hotel, admiring its beautiful Moroccan art and architecture.

For departures from Málaga, enjoy convenient pick-up from various Costa del Sol locations, including Marbella, Estepona, Benalmádena, Málaga Centre, Torremolinos, Nerja, and more.

items.n: Granada Alhambra Group Tour from Malaga Port
items.d: We offer comfortable transportation from the Port of Malaga to the Alhambra, just one and a half hours away. Upon arrival, an official guide will welcome you for a visit to the Alhambra, a UNESCO World Heritage Site and an ancient Palatine city. This 14-hectare monumental complex was home to the elite serving the Sultans of Banu Al Ahmar, the last Muslim dynasty in the Iberian Peninsula. The guided tour includes the Generalife, the summer palace known for its ingenious architecture and refreshing microclimate, followed by the remains of the medina where the Sultan's viziers lived. The visit concludes with the impressive Nasrid Palaces, residence of the 23 Sultans of the Dynasty. Upon completion, you will be comfortably transferred back to the starting point. The full tour lasts approximately 6 hours.

items.n: Boat Tour with XXL Slides, Snorkeling, Activities and Lunch
items.d:
This boat tour along the Costa del Sol goes far beyond a simple sea ride. Unlike other tours, you sail on a large ship, which guarantees greater stability, space, and comfort throughout the experience.
The activity combines dolphin watching, snorkeling, water sports, and water fun in a single excursion. It stands out especially for its two GIGANTIC water slides, an uncommon attraction in this type of tour, which turn the navigation into an exciting experience for all types of travelers.
Additionally, it includes paddle surfing, kayaks, and lunch on board, allowing you to enjoy without rushing and with panoramic views of the Costa del Sol. For greater convenience, the tour includes pick-up and return service from pre-established pick-up points to the Port of Benalmádena.
All of this is done in organized groups, with professional crew, and a focus on safety and the traveler's experience.

items.n: 3-Hours Catamaran Tour in Malaga with Paella
items.d: The spacious catamaran offers us the possibility to sit up or down under cover, while we admire the coast of Malaga from up close. Anchoring, quiet swimming stop, far away from the crowded beaches. After spending a few fantastic hours at sea and enjoying a delicious meal and entertainment for the whole family, we start the return trip to the port. Once back on land, the feeling is always the same: an unforgettable adventure and a great desire to do it all over again.

items.n: Benalmadena Private Boat Tour : OpenBar, Swimming Fun & Dolphins
items.d: Our tour differs because it is completely private and customizable, combining dolphin watching, snorkeling, fishing and fun activities at sea. It includes unlimited drinks and snacks, professional crew, luxury and comfort, and spectacular views of the Costa del Sol, offering a unique experience for families, couples and friends.

items.n: Guided Tour at Caminito del Rey
items.d: Explore the stunning Caminito del Rey on a guided tour that lasts approximately 3 hours. This iconic walkway, suspended over 100 meters above the ground, offers breathtaking views of the surrounding natural beauty and historical significance. With a maximum group size of 30, enjoy an intimate experience led by a certified guide who will share captivating stories about the path's history and its transformation from a dangerous trail to a safe and enchanting walk. Perfect for nature lovers and adventure seekers, this tour is a must-do when in Málaga.

items.n: Full-Day Alhambra from Malaga: Choose Your Access & Pick Up Point
items.d:
Step into a fairytale world of Moorish palaces, serene gardens, and centuries of captivating history at the Alhambra, a UNESCO World Heritage Site that attracts over 2.6 million visitors every year. 

This full-day guided tour from Malaga offers you a hassle-free way to experience one of Europe's most breathtaking architectural masterpieces without the stress of planning transportation or securing sold-out tickets.

Built in the 13th century as the royal court of the Nasrid Dynasty, the Alhambra is a breathtaking testament to Islamic art and architecture. Your expert guide will lead you through the main areas of the monument that have enchanted visitors for 700 years.

If you book the Full Tour option, you will visit the Nasrid Palaces (our most popular choice!), the crown jewel of the Alhambra, the mesmerizing Court of the Lions with its iconic fountain

Please note that, depending on your tour option, the Nasrid Palaces might not be included.

items.n: Malaga Food & Wine Tour: Tapas, Drinks and Delights with a Local
items.d:
Join us on an walking food tour of Malaga, designed for small groups to ensure a personalized and intimate experience. With at least four food stops, you'll have the chance to indulge in a variety of original and local tastings, showcasing the authentic flavors of this vibrant city. Throughout the tour, you'll enjoy a selection of different tapas and drinks, carefully chosen to complement each stop.

Accompanied by a local expert who truly knows the city, you'll dive deep into Málaga’s rich culinary tradition. This guide, a true insider, will share fascinating secrets and stories, taking you to the best restaurants, hidden gems, and eateries that are beloved by locals. Get ready to discover Málaga’s true flavors, away from the tourist crowds!

items.n: Kayaking Adventure: Sea Caves, Virgin Coves and Snorkeling
items.d:
Discover the Natural Area of Maro-Cerro Gordo and be amazed by the history and best kept secrets of the tropical coast.

Hop on board your double or single kayak and head for the Maiden’s Cove. Marvel at its crystal clear waters and stunning turquoise hues.
Sail along cliffs over 300 meters. Watch the marine life around you and you can spot dolphins or mountain goats.
We will make a stop in Calaiza to perform snorkeling and go into sea caves where to see the orange tropical coral.
Photos and videos of the route, you can download the images for free.
Before leaving, your guide will teach you the basics of kayaking and the main safety measures at sea. We will provide you with a bottle of water to keep you hydrated. The tour includes snorkeling equipment, life jacket and watertight bag.
On our routes we promote responsible tourism and the care of the marine environment.

items.n: Malaga Organic Vineyard & Winery: 6 Wines, 2 Oils & Transfer
items.d: Discover Málaga’s organic wine country on a relaxed 4.5-hour small-group experience with round-trip transport from Plaza de la Marina 11. Travel to a family-run organic vineyard and winery in Mijas, walk among the vines and olive trees, and learn how the wines are produced. Taste 6 organic wines and 2 family-produced organic extra virgin olive oils. Each guest receives 5 small pairings, complemented by shared platters of Iberian cured meats, Málaga cheeses, Spanish tortilla, olives and snacks, plus water. Hosted in English for adults aged 18+, the regular group is limited to 8 guests. Daily departures are at 10:00 and 16:00, subject to live availability.

items.n: Bay of Malaga Catamaran Sailing
items.d:
Sail the Malaga coast with this eco sailing catamaran cruise around the bay. You'll enjoy stunning views of the capital of the Costa del Sol in this unforgettable boat trip!
The cruise leaves at the indicated time from Malaga's Pier 1, ready to set sail on the Mediterranean on a luxurious catamaran yacht.
From on deck you'll enjoy some stunning views of the area, with the port's modern architecture, with one of the most avant-garde buildings in the city, the Pompidou Centre. And as you get further and further out from the coast, the distinctive skyline of the Costa del Sol's capital will come into view.
The cruise also takes in sights such as the famous La Malagueta beach, the Malaga Bullring, Alcazaba and the Gibralfaro castle. And as the cruise continues around the coast you'll see the towns and beaches that make up the aptly named Costa del Sol: one of the places with most daylight hours in all of Spain!

items.n: Arabian Baths Experience at Malaga’s Hammam Al Andalus
items.d: Recline and relax in Malaga’s heavenly Hammam Al Ándalus, a luxurious Arabian baths located near the old Medina. Head inside to unwind and spend 1.5 hours at leisure in the opulently designed thermal baths and steam room. Sip on mint tea, while away time in the baths, and then head to the Aroma Corner for a 15-minute massage or 30-minute massage with an exfoliating scrub. Alternatively, upgrade to a Midra purifying massage that exfoliates and stimulates circulation.

items.n: Caminito del Rey Tour from Malaga
items.d: Join us on this full day excursion to Caminito del Rey from Costa del Sol where you can enjoy the views of the Andalusian white villages along the way. In addition, you will be able to recharge your batteries and get to know the picturesque town of Ardales before starting the hiking route. Enjoy an amazing experience and spectacular views along Caminito del Rey. Learn about the history of once considered world’s most dangerous pathway. Get on your walking shoes!

items.n: Caminito del Rey with Pickup from Malaga City
items.d: From Málaga City. Relax aboard a Premium Bus with air conditioning on our way to the Caminito del Rey day trip. Listen as your guide who speaks German, and English, tells you about the surroundings and history. At the beginning of the hike, you will receive a fresh bottle of water. Feel the thrill of walking above the Guadalhorce River from the north access point and make your way for approximately 3 hours in a guided tour, and have time to take photos of the landscape along the route and admire the beauty of the Gaitanes Gorge. At the end of the hike, you´ll get together with your guide again and the bus will pick you up, enjoy and relax on the way back to your starting point

items.n: Malaga Private Eco Tuk Tuk Expert Tour with Local Guide
items.d:
Discover Malaga in the most comfortable and fun way with this Eco Tuk Tuk tour. Don’t miss anything to see in this great city, get to know in a single trip the mixture of ancient history, folklore and modern culture. Ask us to take the best pictures you will take on the trip.

Walk through centuries of history as you discover the imposing Alcazaba and the elegance of Malaga Cathedral effortlessly

 - Admire the grandiosity and millennial history of the Alcazaba from a comfortable tuk tuk.
 - Experience the city in an ecological and fun way aboard an electric tuk tuk, 100% silent and sustainable.
 - Tour the most emblematic corners of Malaga while feeling its culture, tradition and urban energy.

Immerse yourself in the essence of Malaga: culture, folklore and vibrant urban life in every corner you visit

Make your stay in Malaga an unforgettable experience and take a great memory of this wonderful city!

items.n: Epic Caminito del Rey Adventure: Guided Tour & Guaranteed Ticket
items.d:
The Caminito del Rey is more than just a trail; it is an unforgettable guided journey through the walls of the Desfiladero de los Gaitanes, one of Andalusia's most breathtaking natural wonders.

Imagine walking on suspended boardwalks, bolted directly into the vertical cliff face, 100 meters above the Guadalhorce River. Feel the rush of adrenaline as you traverse the gorge, looking down into the deep chasm that few ever see. This incredible route offers stunning views of the canyon's geology and vibrant Mediterranean nature, all within one of Málaga's protected natural spaces.

Our Expert Guided Tour transforms this thrilling walk into a rich historical experience. You will not only witness the path's remarkable reconstruction but also uncover the thrilling tales of its original purpose, built over a century ago as a vital passage for hydroelectric workers, offering a powerful contrast between the past and the present.

CHILDREN UNDER 8 YEARS OLD ARE NOT ALLOWED TO ENTER THE TRAIL.

items.n: Tour: Dolphins & Sailing Small-Group Benalmádena Catamaran
items.d:
Sailing on a catamaran from Benalmádena (Puerto Marina, Málaga) is the best way to enjoy a dream vacation with family or friends in the surroundings of Benalmádena and Málaga. The new Lagoon offers a combination of luxury and comfort at low cost for a small group of 12 people.

Several departures during the day:
1h: 10:00, 11:00, 12:00, 13:00h
2h: 10:00, 14:30, 19:30h.

Boarding will be done without queues. Our crew will accompany you through a small platform that connects the port with our boat.

While we sail, our skipper will try to spot dolphins or other marine life. While these majestic animals are free range and we cannot always guarantee this, each tour is unique and gives you the opportunity to reconnect with nature. 

During the journey, you will enjoy a complimentary drink and snack (chips) to accompany it.

If the weather permits, we can raise the sails and sail while listening to the waves and we will even make stops to enjoy a refreshing swim, paddle surf or snorkel.

items.n: Private Tour to La Alhambra de Granada from Malaga
items.d: Discover one of Spain’s most impressive treasures on a day trip from Malaga to Granada. The tour begins in the majestic Alhambra, the Nasrid palace declared a World Heritage Site, where you will tour its gardens, courtyards and halls full of history and beauty, while enjoying the best views of the city and the Sierra Nevada. Then you will have free time to explore the center of Granada at your own pace, wander through its charming streets, discover the atmosphere of Plaza Nueva, be surprised by the picturesque Albaicín neighborhood or taste the famous Granada tapas in one of its traditional bars. A complete experience that combines culture, history and leisure in one of the most fascinating destinations in Andalusia, with comfortable transport from Malaga and tickets included so you only worry about enjoying

items.n: Nerja, Nerja and Frigiliana Caves Day Trip
items.d:
Discover the Andalusian charm of the Costa del Sol on a 1-day excursion to Frigiliana, the Cave of Nerja, the Balcony of Europe and the old city of Nerja, with pick-up in Torremolinos, Benalmadena and Malaga Centro. Travel by comfortable air-conditioned bus through one of the most captivating regions of southern Spain.

It starts in Frigiliana, a whitewashed village with cobblestone streets, florid corners and Andalusian atmosphere. Stroll through its alleys and taste its famous sweet wine.

Continue to Nerja Cave, a natural wonder with rock art, stalactites and stalagmites that link nature and history.

From the Balcony of Europe, enjoy breathtaking views of the Mediterranean and, on clear days, the African skyline.

Explore the old town of Nerja: whitewashed streets, shops, cafes and restaurants with authentic Andalusian charm since the 16th century.

After a day full of scenery, culture and history, relax on the return trip to Torremolinos, Benalmadena and Malaga.

items.n: Tour Welcome to Malaga in Eco Tuk Tuk Private with Local Guide
items.d:
120 minutes of fun on one of the most complete tours of Malaga city. With Eco Tuk Tuk we will not only take you through the most touristic sites, but we will also discover those places that not everyone gets to know, and that make Malaga one of the most special cities in Spain. Discover Malaga as you have never seen it in the comfort of electric tuk-tuk and don’t miss any details.

 Be surprised by the majesty of the Alcazaba and the history that its walls hide.
 - Feel like the city come to life as you ride its streets in an electric, silent and eco-friendly tuk tuk.
 - Tour Malaga’s iconic squares, avenues and monuments on a journey full of culture and tradition.

Make your stay in Malaga an unforgettable experience and take a great memory of this wonderful city!

items.n: The Best of Málaga and Nearby White Coastal Villages
items.d:
Discover the best of Málaga and its surroundings on this complete private experience combining history, culture, stunning views, and authentic local charm.

Explore Málaga’s historic center with your private guide as you walk through its elegant streets, visit iconic landmarks such as the Alcazaba, the Roman Theatre, Málaga Cathedral, and Picasso’s birthplace, and experience the vibrant atmosphere of the Atarazanas Market.

Continue beyond the city to discover the beauty of Benalmádena, a charming Andalusian white village overlooking the Mediterranean. Visit the impressive Colomares Castle, the peaceful Buddhist Stupa, and the iconic Bil-Bil Castle by the sea while enjoying breathtaking coastal views.

This relaxed and personalized tour offers the perfect balance between cultural discovery and scenic landscapes, with time to enjoy Málaga at your own pace. Your guide will share local stories, historical insights, and insider recommendations to make your experience truly unforgettable.

items.n: Nerja & Frigiliana Private Day Trip from Malaga or Marbella
items.d:
Private day trip combining three of the best places east 
of Málaga — the Nerja Caves, the Balcón de Europa, and 
the white village of Frigiliana. Just your group, 
door-to-door hotel pickup from Málaga, Marbella, or 
anywhere on the Costa del Sol.

YOUR DAY INCLUDES:

- Nerja Caves — discovered in 1959, 40,000-year-old 
 prehistoric paintings, a stalactite column with a 
 Guinness World Record for size. Cave ticket included.
- Balcón de Europa — clifftop promenade above the sea 
 named by King Alfonso XII in 1884.
- Frigiliana — one of the best-preserved Moorish 
 quarters in Andalusia. Ceramic tile murals, 
 whitewashed lanes, views to the sea.

The caves stay at 18°C year-round — a genuine relief 
in summer.

Costa Excursions — private tour operator based in 
Mijas since 2012. 4.9★ TripAdvisor, 175+ reviews. 
Thomas and Peter personally lead every tour.

items.n: Granada and The Alhambra Private Tour From Malaga
items.d:
Experience the breathtaking beauty of the Alhambra on a fully private day trip from Málaga to Granada. Upon arrival, enjoy a 3-hour exclusive guided tour of the Alhambra, where your personal guide will lead you through the stunning Nasrid Palaces, the lush Generalife Gardens, and the iconic Alcazaba, along with other fascinating areas of this historic site.

After your tour, you’ll have 3 hours of free time to explore the vibrant streets of Granada at your own pace. Take a leisurely stroll, discover hidden gems, or enjoy a delicious local meal. If you prefer, you also have the option to add a private tour of the city to learn more about its rich history and culture. In total, this unforgettable experience lasts approximately 9 hours, offering a full day of exploration and enjoyment.

items.n: Paella and Sangria Workshop in Malaga
items.d:
In this experience you will learn dishes of Andalusian cuisine, such as ajoblanco and Malaga salad, which we finish with a Paella, the first recipe known in Spain.
During the class, the chef will show her clients tips on where to buy good products and sites in Malaga that they should visit, as well as interesting gastronomic sites. 
They are fun, enjoyable and 100% participatory classes. 

A minimum of 4 people is required to take the class.

items.n: Sunset or night catamaran tour from Malaga
items.d:
Come enjoy a different experience on board our catamaran
The best scenery you can contemplate at sea is undoubtedly the moment of sunset. This excursion takes you out to sea aboard the Marine World catamaran, from where you can enjoy the romantic moment when the sun slowly disappears on the Horizon. During the walk there are spectacular views of the coast, the port and the city of Malaga at sunset.

items.n: Mijas Mountains Buggy Tour Costa del Sol
items.d: In this tour you will experience off roading to the max. We take you into the Sierra de Mijas Mountains where we drive through dirt tracks, riverbeds & take a stop at a mountain viewpoint.

items.n: Gibraltar with St Michael Caves Guided Tour from Costa del Sol
items.d: Have a hassle free journey to Gibraltar. Board an air-conditioned coach from Costa del Sol and visit this strategic part of the world. Enjoy a guided tour and learn about the historic significance of the Rock. See some of the most important sights and visit St. Michael’s Cave.

items.n: Málaga: Highlights, Hidden Gems and Coast Vintage Bike Tour
items.d:
Discover the magic of Málaga with style, comfort, and a local friend.

Forget about tired feet and boring history lectures. Hop on one of our colorful vintage bicycles and glide through the city’s history, culture, and seaside vibes.

On this tour, we blend the "Must-See" monuments with the secret corners that only locals know. You will cycle through the winding streets of the Old Town, marvel at the Roman Theatre and Alcazaba, and feel the Mediterranean breeze along the Promenade.

Why choose Bizi-Tour?
The Best Photos: Our vintage bikes are the most photogenic in town.
Small Groups: We keep it intimate for a family/friend vibe.
Local Storytelling: We share legends, fun facts, and daily life anecdote, not just dates.
Easy Ride: Málaga is flat and we ride at a relaxed pace, suitable for all fitness levels.

items.n: Discover Granada : Alhambra Tour or Free Time from Malaga
items.d:
Enjoy a comfortable bus ride from your pick-up point on the Costa del Sol, with panoramic views of Sierra Nevada and a breakfast stop. Upon arrival in Granada, choose your ideal experience.

Option 1: Granada at Your Own Pace
5 hours to explore Granada at your leisure. No Alhambra tickets included. Discover the Cathedral, Plaza Nueva, Carrera del Darro, Calle Elvira, and Paseo de los Tristes.

Option 2: Complete Alhambra
Guided tour of the Nasrid Palaces, Generalife, Gardens, Alcazaba, Medina, and Palace of Carlos V.

Option 3: Essential Alhambra
Guided tour of the most important Alhambra monuments (excluding the Nasrid Palaces), with free time to explore Granada.

For options with Alhambra entry, you’ll have time to explore the city center before the guided tour.

Afterward, return directly to your pick-up point in Malaga.

items.n: Dolphin Watching in Catamaran from Benalmadena
items.d:
Set sail along the stunning Costa del Sol on a spacious and comfortable catamaran, perfect for families, couples, and groups of friends. Enjoy a relaxing 2-hour cruise with plenty of room to sunbathe, unwind, and take in the beautiful coastal views of Benalmadena and Malaga.

During the trip, our experienced captain will navigate open waters in search of dolphins and other marine life in their natural habitat. While sightings cannot be guaranteed, each excursion offers a unique and exciting connection with nature.

Weather permitting, you may also enjoy a refreshing swim in the Mediterranean Sea. With multiple daily departures (10:00h, 12:30h, 16:30h, 19:00h), this experience offers flexibility and great value for money—an ideal way to enjoy the sea and create unforgettable holiday memories.

items.n: Tangier, Morocco Day Trip from Costa del Sol
items.d: Discover the magic of Morocco on a day trip to Tangier from Costa del Sol. Morocco lies just across the Mediterranean Sea from south Spain, but this North African country feels like a world away! Your full-day adventure includes a Berber typical performance and Moroccan lunch, a walking tour of the medina, souk and kasbah, time for shopping at a Tangier bazaar, and round-trip ferry transfers – the ultimate value for a day in Morocco.

items.n: The Premium Experience at Teatro Flamenco Málaga
items.d:
In the heart of Málaga, Teatro Flamenco Málaga presents “Esencia,” a show that combines the passion of singing, dancing, and guitar with the elegance of the bolero school.
The heart of the show lies in its three pillars: singing, dancing, and guitar, performed by top-level artists who master flamenco techniques.
As a special highlight, the performance includes a distinctive demonstration of the traditional Bolero school, a unique feature rarely offered elsewhere.

• Top-level artists mastering all flamenco techniques.

• Intimate setting that brings the audience close to the performers.

• State-of-the-art venue to enjoy every detail of flamenco without distractions.

• Ideal for tourists and flamenco enthusiasts seeking quality and tradition.

• Soft drinks and other beverages can be purchased directly at the theater.

• Children’s tickets available at a reduced price.

items.n: Full Day Guided Malaga Ronda Day Tour
items.d:
Ronda is one of the few cities that cannot be compared and does not look like any other city in Spain. One of the most visited in the province in Malaga.
discover its impressive 98-meter-high New Bridge!

Setenil de las Bodegas, a unique small town for having most of its houses built into the rock, a beautiful walk that you will not forget!

Do not miss this unique experience!

items.n: Paella Cooking Class with English Guide in Malaga
items.d: Put on your apron and immerse yourself in the wonderful experience of making an authentic Spanish paella with us. We take a genuine approach, using fresh, locally sourced ingredients and traditional spices to bring the dish to life. And remember, you will enjoy eating your culinary creation, so come with an appetite!

items.n: From Costa del Sol: The Gibraltar Classic Rock tour
items.d:
The Rock is a British overseas territory located on a small peninsula at the southern tip of the Iberian Peninsula, bordering only Spain. It is historically recognized as the southernmost point of Europe and sits at the western end of the Mediterranean, forming one of the ancient columns of Hercules. The Rock is primarily made of Jurassic limestone, dating back around 200 million years. Upon arrival, we’ll visit the famous Apes’ Den and explore the stunning Saint Michael’s Caves. 

Afterward, enjoy free time for tax-free shopping on Main Street or uncover hidden gems such as the Gibraltar Museum or the narrow streets and historic buildings of the old town. 

Take time to soak in the unique atmosphere of this fascinating destination, blending nature, history, and culture, all within a compact yet fascinating landscape. Whether you’re shopping or sightseeing, there’s plenty to discover in this iconic spot.

items.n: Fom Costa del Sol: Ronda and Setenil Tour with Tasting Experience
items.d:
This day trip to Ronda and Setenil de las Bodegas from Málaga and Costa del Sol is a perfect combination for discovering two of the most beautiful villages in Andalusia.

Travel through the scenic countryside, passing white villages like Ardales and Cuevas del Becerro.

Our first stop is Setenil de las Bodegas, famous for its houses built under huge rock overhangs. Enjoy 1.5 hours of free time to stroll along Cuevas del Sol and Cuevas de la Sombra streets, down Jabonería Street to Plaza de Andalucía, and take a photo at the romantic “Kiss me in this corner” sign.

Then, continue to Ronda, just 17 km away. Join a 1.5-hour guided tour through the Alameda del Tajo, the iconic Puente Nuevo, and the old town, including entrance to the Don Bosco House with views of the gorge. Here, you will also enjoy a tasting of the famous Yemas del Tajo and local sweet wine. After the guided tour, enjoy free time to try local cuisine.

Return to Málaga and your pick-up point from Ronda.

items.n: From Malaga, Gibraltar excursion with transport
items.d:
A must-see destination when visiting Andalusia. 
The huge Rock and uniqueness of this place, belonging to the United Kingdom, makes it very special

From the rock of Gibraltar you can see 2 continents (Africa and Europe), 3 countries (Morocco, Spain and England) and the Atlantic Ocean and the Mediterranean Sea!!! Definitely a unique place. 
In addition, Gibraltar hosts the only monkey colony in Europe! Get on the rock and take a picture with them. 
To finish the day, discover the tunnels of World War II, the colorful caves of San Michael, the sky walk, the Windsor suspension bridge... They are one of the many things you can discover in this Rock full of surprises.

 There have been no border controls since 15.7.2026. Gibraltar is Shengen space. 
This means that anyone can visit Gibraltar.
 - Gibraltar is part of the United Kingdom and it is possible to pay by cash (euros) and card. No problem,a

items.n: Malaga Traditional Wine & Tapas Tour
items.d:
Discover the hidden gems of Malaga's gastronomy with a local! Eat, drink and enjoy like a local! 

We'll make an amazing tour visiting three wineries and taverns. I'll explain you the differences between each wine and how to cook the tapas we'll taste. When walking from one place to the next one, we'll see the most important monuments of the city centre and I'll telll you the history of Malaga's city, wine and tapas from the very beggining! Don't doubt, this is the more authentic tapas and wine tour you can make in Malaga! :D

items.n: Sunset Sailing along the Marbella coast from Puerto Banus
items.d:
Embark on a unique sailing trip to witness one of the most magical and romantic moments of the day. This tour is ideal for those looking to unwind, enjoy the calm sea and admire the sunset from a unique perspective.
There is no better place to see the day end than from the deck of a sailboat, with good company, music, drinks and snacks.

items.n: Discover the Treasure Cave: Unique Electric Car Tour in Málaga
items.d:
This exclusive tour takes you on an unforgettable journey to two incredible locations. Begin by exploring the vibrant streets of central Málaga, full of culture and history. Then, head to the coastal town of Rincón de la Victoria to visit the famous Cueva del Tesoro, the only marine-origin cave in Europe and one of the most fascinating in the world.

Enjoy a guided experience where you’ll uncover the secrets of this extraordinary natural treasure, from its unique rock formations to its centuries-old legends. The visit lasts approximately 45–60 minutes, with plenty of time to marvel at the beauty around you.

Perfect for adventurers, nature enthusiasts, and those seeking a unique glimpse into Málaga’s history and natural wonders, this tour combines exploration, education, and stunning scenery.

items.n: Round and Setenil of the Wineries with Transport from Malaga
items.d:
Discover Ronda and Setenil de las Bodegas on a day trip from Malaga, designed for travelers seeking an authentic, flexible and Andalusian-flavored experience.

In Ronda you can explore the city at your own pace or with a guide, depending on the option chosen, with real support to enjoy its history, gastronomy, monuments and most emblematic corners. In addition, you will have access to an interactive map and videos of Lucia and Manu in your language, to learn more about places such as the church, the bullring, the Tagus and other highlights.

Our guides will help you personalize your visit with recommendations on food, flamenco, monuments or special corners, always without unnecessary extra costs.

If you choose the option of wines and tapas on a NON-GUIDED tour, you will enjoy Casa Museo Don Bosco, wine tasting “a pinchos”, Andalusian tapas and 10% discount in its store.

Then you will visit Setenil, with shuttle train included to travel it in more comfort.

items.n: Malaga Market Food Tour: Tapas, Drinks, and Local Flavors
items.d:
The Do Eat Better Experience food tour is a walking tour around the historical center of Malaga. You will be guided by a Local Expert who's able to explain every detail of the selected restaurants, their preparations, and any other relevant curiosities.

Do Eat Better Experience tours are a mix of high-quality gastronomy as a way of showing spanish culture and lifestyle and a walking experience together with a local friend. This is the reason why we accept small groups only: we want to focus on a genuine exchange and give to each tourist the highest attention possible.

Please, note that the tour is always run in English and Spanish; other languages upon request.

items.n: Ferry Benalmádena  Fuengirola
items.d:
Discover the Ferry Between Benalmádena and Fuengirola

Enjoy a scenic and comfortable trip on our ferry connecting Benalmádena Marina with Fuengirola. Here’s why this journey stands out:

 - Spectacular Views
Admire stunning coastal landscapes and capture memorable photos of iconic landmarks during your ride.

️- Visit Fuengirola
Explore this charming town, known for its sandy beaches and vibrant markets held on Tuesdays, Saturdays, and Sundays, offering local goods and unique souvenirs.

- Dolphin Spotting
Watch for dolphins as they often play in the waters along the route, adding a touch of wonder to your trip.

- A Relaxing Alternative
Forget crowded buses and travel in style with this refreshing and unforgettable ferry experience.

Whether for a day trip or a one-way adventure, this ferry offers a unique way to connect two beautiful destinations.

items.n: Ultimate Malaga History & Tapas - All Included Full Experience
items.d:
Discover the must-see places of Málaga with a licensed local guide on this Ultimate Málaga Food & Culture Experience. Explore major attractions like the Alcazaba Fortress, Roman Theater, and Cathedral, along with hidden gems—all with skip-the-line access included. 

After this immersive journey through history, enjoy delicious local food paired with the finest Spanish wines at two different restaurants, all included in this Ultimate Experience in Málaga, Spain. 

This unique combination of history and cuisine offers you simply the best of both worlds!

** Please note that the Cathedral of Malaga is closed on Sundays and special holidays, we will have an in depth exterior visit instead. The opening hours can be changed by the Diocese of Malaga within minutes

items.n: Marbella 2 - hour Catamaran Group Excursion with Dolphin Watching
items.d:
Enjoy aboard our beautiful catamaran Lagoon 380 from the sun and the sea breeze as well as the possibility to see dolphins in freedom for 2 hours and meet new people!

We offer small group excursions (maximum 12 people) that will make you live this experience in a different and unique way. Our crew will guide you at all times about safety concepts on board as well as a good use of the equipment available during the excursion (paddle surfing boards, snorkeling and fishing equipment, availability of use alongside sea conditions). 

The planning of our activity, whenever the weather conditions permit, will be to sail in search of the dolphins in freedom, anchor to enjoy the bath in the high seas, paddle surf and snorkel boards and back to home port enjoying a drink type soft drink, beer, water.

items.n: Caminito del Rey Private Tour from Málaga Cruise Port
items.d:
Embark on a mesmerizing private trip from the cruise port to experience the awe-inspiring beauty of El Caminito del Rey, a fascinating trekking activity set in a magical location. This adventure promises to leave you impressed with its suspended walkway, dramatic gorges, deep canyons, and a thrilling hanging bridge.

This private experience ensures a personalized and unforgettable exploration of one of Spain's hidden gems.

A path that winds through breathtaking landscapes. Discover the suspended walkway that offers unparalleled views and a thrilling experience.

Traverse the Gaitanejos and Gaitanes ravines, marveling at the natural beauty that surrounds you. Each step unveils the geological wonders of the area, making it a memorable journey through diverse landscapes.

Explore the Hoyo Valley, a scenic area with its own unique charm. Witness the natural wonders, rock formations, and the captivating allure that has made El Caminito del Rey a must-visit destination.

items.n: Sevilla Private Full day Tour From Malaga
items.d:
Enjoy a full-day private tour from Málaga to Seville, the vibrant capital of Andalusia. Your driver will pick you up from your accommodation for a comfortable journey through picturesque southern landscapes, leading to one of Spain’s most enchanting cities. 

Upon arrival, embark on a 2-hour private walking tour with a local guide, exploring Seville’s most iconic landmarks. Stroll through the historic center, admire the stunning Giralda and Seville Cathedral from the outside, and walk along the charming streets of Santa Cruz, the city’s old Jewish quarter. Learn about Seville’s rich history, from its Moorish past to its golden age of exploration. 

After the guided tour, enjoy free time to savor Seville’s delicious cuisine, visit additional sights like the Plaza de España or the Alcázar, or simply relax by the Guadalquivir River. In the afternoon, reunite with your driver for a scenic return to Málaga, ending a day filled with history, culture, and unforgettable experiences.

items.n: Paella Cooking Class in Malaga
items.d: Learn with how to cook Spain’s most famous dish in Malaga from a chef on this 3.5-hour hands-on cooking class. Meet your chef guide and head to Malaga’s finest market, where you’ll learn about the ingredients necessary to make the best paella and other tasty Spanish dishes. Enjoy a traditional lunch and wine with new friends and bring home new cooking inspiration and recipes.

items.n: Caminito del Rey from Malaga : Round Trip Bus + Official Guide
items.d:
Direct transportation from the heart of Malaga for comfort. No worries and greater enjoyment.

Learn about the history and nature of Caminito del Rey thanks to our specialized guides who not only know the history, they live it! We are passionate about active tourism and exploring Malaga. Founded more than 8 years ago, our agency has been dedicated to offering unique and personalized experiences in the region. We specialize in hiking trips, visits to historic sites and nature tourism, always with a focus on safety and customer satisfaction.

What's included?

items.n: Nerja & Frigiliana Tour from Málaga
items.d: Acompáñanos en una emocionante excursión para descubrir dos joyas de la Axarquía, en Málaga: Nerja y Frigiliana. ¡Disfruta de la belleza de la Costa del Sol!

items.n: Catamaran tour with swimming stop in Malaga
items.d: The Mundo Marino Catamaran to enjoy a relaxed and quiet swim away from the crowded beaches. After spending a fantastic time in the Mediterranean, we began the journey back to the port. Once on land, the feeling is always the same: an unforgettable adventure and the desire to repeat it again.

items.n: Private Alhambra and Granada Tour from Marbella or Malaga Port
items.d:
Explore the wonders of Granada with a private full-day tour to the Alhambra and the historical center. Choose between two convenient departure points: from Málaga or its port (9-hour service) or from Marbella (10-hour service). Both options include a private driver, roundtrip transportation, skip-the-line entrance to the Alhambra, and a 4-hour private guided tour covering both the Alhambra complex and Granada’s old town.

Discover the Nasrid Palaces, the Generalife Gardens, and the Alcazaba fortress, then continue with a cultural walk through the city’s historic streets, visiting landmarks such as the Albaicín and Plaza Nueva. Your expert guide will adapt the tour to your interests, providing deep insight into Granada’s rich Islamic and Christian heritage.

This private experience ensures comfort, flexibility, and an unforgettable journey into one of Spain’s most captivating cities — ideal for cruise passengers, couples, or small groups seeking an in-depth cultural adventure.

items.n: The Ultimate Tapas Workshop in Malaga
items.d: Immerse yourself in a hands-on tapas cooking class led by local experts, where you'll delve into the heart of Spanish cuisine beyond the basics. Our guides and chefs, seasoned in Malaga's culinary traditions, will take you on a journey from selecting fresh, seasonal ingredients at the bustling local market to mastering the art of tapas creation. Learn the authentic meaning and making of tapas, from Ajoblanco Malagueño to Tortilla de Patatas, in a workshop that's interactive, not merely a demonstration. With options for all dietary needs, discover culinary techniques to bring the spirit of Malaga's and Spanish kitchens into your home.

items.n: Alhambra, Nasrid Palaces and Generalife Private Tour from Malaga
items.d:
Discover one of the most extraordinary monuments in the world on this 7 to 8-hour private tour of the Alhambra, guided by a professional art historian who brings centuries of Islamic civilization to life.

Your experience includes skip-the-line access, Alhambra Gardens and Generalife tickets, and a private walk through the breathtaking summer palace and gardens. Nasrid Palaces admission is fully included — we strongly recommend booking well in advance, as these tickets are among the most sought-after in the world.

Pickup and drop-off is included from your hotel, Airbnb, or port in Málaga and surrounds, in a comfortable private van or car. Cruise passengers enjoy priority scheduling.

This is not a group tour. Every detail — from your pickup time to the pace of the visit — is tailored entirely to you.

items.n: Taste of Malaga Tour : Tapas, History and Local Customs
items.d:
In this half-day activity, food lovers will discover the traditional products, dishes and hidden treasures of Malaga. During the tour, learn about the history of Malaga’s gastronomy and visit the city's local hot spots. 

Small Group of just 12 people max

items.n: Boat Tour with Snorkeling, Slide, Lunch and Pick Up
items.d:
-Sea Adventure

-Snorkel equipment
