items.n: Private Luxury Tangier Tour From Malaga / Marbella or Tarifa
items.d:
Changing a continent could be a good idea for one day.
Tangier known for its international status for a long time welcomes travelers from many countries and is a gateway to Africa that brings together many civilizations and ancient societies. Famous for minarets, Moorish architecture and busty lifestyle it reveals the beauty of Mediterranean and Atlantic nature 
Explore spectacular panoramic views over Tangier's old and new city. You will be on the Mediterranean and Atlantic sides in one day, visiting predicates park, cap spartel, Hercules caves, seeing the meeting point of the Mediterranean Sea and the Atlantic Ocean and great lovely camels on the Achakar beach. Finally you will start with a walking part in Tangier Medina to see Kasbah and a museum, Berber markets, a food market, the Grand Rocco, American Legation, and more. During the tour, we stop for a Moroccan traditional lunch. A cup of refreshing mint tea or fresh orange juice will make the best of the day! Have a great tour!

items.n: Private Malaga: Alcazaba, Museum, Market, Cathedral & Picasso
items.d: Discover Málaga’s rich history and vibrant culture on a private tour that captures the city’s highlights! Begin with the iconic Alcazaba, a Moorish fortress with stunning views, and explore fascinating artifacts at the Archaeological Museum. Stroll through the bustling Atarazanas Market (closed Sundays) to experience local flavors, then marvel at the grandeur of Málaga Cathedral. Finally, immerse yourself in the world of Picasso by visiting his birthplace. Perfect for those looking to uncover the heart of Málaga with an expert guide!

items.n: Guided Tour with Transportation from Malaga to Caminito del Rey
items.d:
Explore the stunning Caminito del Rey on a guided tour from Malaga that combines nature, history and breathtaking views. 

Behold the beauty of this iconic walkway suspended above a gorge, guided by a professional expert who offers information in both Spanish and English. 

Enjoy hassle-free round-trip transportation, a welcome package upon arrival and the chance to win memories in a special draw. 

Perfect for adventure lovers, families and history enthusiasts, this 7-hour experience guarantees you a memorable day in the heart of Andalusia. 

 - 7-hour guided tour including return bus from Malaga
 - Discover the Caminito del Rey with an official bilingual guide
 - Welcome package and opportunity to participate in a souvenir giveaway
 - Groups divided by language for a personalized experience

items.n: Horse and Flamenco Show in Malaga
items.d:
Club Hípico El Ranchito has for you an unusual show, based on rhythm and discipline, music and beauty: ‘Ritmo a Caballo’, a show of authentic Andalusian horses!

New in 2025: Discover the secrets of our equestrian artists during 30-minute guided tours at 5pm. This option allows you to learn all about their training and care, with free priority seating so you don't have to worry about finding a place after the tour.

From 5:45 pm and for 90 minutes, divided into different numbers, you will enjoy an equestrian and Andalusian flamenco show with 20 horses, riders, horsewomen and flamenco dancer, let yourself be amazed!

With your ticket you get free parking, free wifi and a non-numbered seat, as well as access to all our available facilities. In our bar and shop we only accept cash.

items.n: La Herradura: Sailboat with a view of dolphins-Shared
items.d:
We will sail on a magnificent 12-meter sailboat, through the crystal clear waters of the Maro-Cerro Gordo natural park, visiting its cliffs and wild coves of turquoise waters.

In high season (June 1st to October 15th) we will anchor in a cove so you can enjoy time for bathing, snorkeling, surf paddling...

We will sail along this incredible coast admiring the beauty and diversity of marine flora and fauna of the natural park.
We will walk along the most common sighting routes of dolphins and other marine species.
Although we can’t guarantee to see dolphins on each of our outings to the sea, you’ll enjoy the full sailing experience and the environment of mountains, natural classes and turquoise waters through which the activity takes place.
They will be offered welcome catering so they can toast this wonderful experience.
Small groups.
The captain has great experience and professionalism.

items.n: Gibraltar and Dolphin Watching Excursion from Malaga
items.d:
Embark on a unique adventure from Malaga and the Costa del Sol (Torremolinos, Benalmadena, Fuengirola, Marbella, Estepona). Relax on the bus as our guide shares fascinating facts about Gibraltar, the famous British colony.

Once we cross the border, enjoy free time to stroll through vibrant Main Street, shop, or explore the charming Casemates Square.

The experience intensifies as we board for a 1.5-hour boat tour through the Strait of Gibraltar, a UNESCO Biosphere Reserve. Sail between the Mediterranean and Atlantic, spotting dolphins and other cetaceans in their natural habitat, while our guide shares interesting facts about these creatures.

After the boat tour, you’ll have more free time to explore Gibraltar or savor its delicious cuisine before returning to your pick-up point.

items.n: Private Tour of Ronda and Setenil de Las Bodegas
items.d:
Discover the enchanting allure of Andalusia with this exclusive private tour. This immersive experience leads you through the cobblestone streets of Ronda, a city perched atop a dramatic gorge and steeped in history. Marvel at its awe-inspiring bridges, ancient bullring, and stunning architecture, while learning about the city's significant historical role.
But the journey doesn't end there. Venture into the charming town of Setenil de las Bodegas, known for its unique houses built into the rocky cliffs, offering a remarkable sight and an unmissable photo opportunity. Traverse the narrow lanes, uncover hidden gems, and enjoy the warm hospitality of the local inhabitants.
No tour of Andalusia would be complete without savoring the region's world-famous olive oil ( Optional ). Indulge your senses in a curated olive oil tasting experience. Learn about the intricate process of producing olive oil and appreciate the diverse flavors, aromas, and textures of the finest oils from the region.

items.n: Sailing Adventure: Sailing, Dolphins and Relaxation with Drinks
items.d:
- Guided navigation by experts on our modern boats.
- Possibility of seeing dolphins and other marine animals.
- Drinks on board: water, soft drinks, beer, white wine and cava.

In addition, you will be able to visit Puerto Banús, one of the most famous ports in the world for its luxury and modernity. This is a tourist spot that you cannot miss if you come to Marbella.

items.n: Malaga City Tour 2 Hours Monumental Segway Tour
items.d:
Discover Malaga’s Highlights on a 2-Hour Monumental Segway Tour!

Join us for a thrilling 2-hour Segway tour through Malaga’s most iconic sights, led by a knowledgeable local guide. This tour combines history, culture, and stunning views for a unique experience that’s perfect for travelers of all interests.

Whether you’re a history enthusiast, art lover, or simply looking for an exciting way to see the city, this Segway tour offers a comprehensive and enjoyable experience. Book now to glide through Malaga’s monumental sites and experience the beauty and history of this vibrant city from a new perspective!

items.n: Ronda Private Wine Tour + Free Time in Ronda
items.d:
Private full-day wine experience combining a morning 
tasting at Finca La Melonera organic winery and free 
time in Ronda. Just your group — door-to-door hotel 
pickup from Malaga, Marbella, or anywhere on the 
Costa del Sol.

FINCA LA MELONERA:
Organic biodynamic winery in the DO Sierras de Málaga, 
15 minutes from Ronda. Ancient native grape varieties — 
Tintilla, Melonera, Rome — that almost disappeared and 
survive almost nowhere else. 4-5 wines, artisan tapas, 
barrel rooms, vineyard walk. One of the most 
distinctive wineries in southern Spain.

RONDA:
Free time in Ronda after the winery — Puente Nuevo 
bridge over El Tajo gorge, old town, bullring (oldest 
in Spain, 1785), viewpoints. Your guide recommends 
where to lunch.

Costa Excursions — Mijas since 2012. 4.9★ TripAdvisor, 
175+ reviews.

items.n: Mijas and Marbella with Puerto Banús and Colomares Castle Tour
items.d: This tour is perfect for those who want to discover the essence of Andalusia in a single day, enjoying comfortable transportation, free time to explore at their own pace, and the insights of an expert guide. From the flower-filled streets and panoramic views of Mijas Pueblo, to the luxury of Puerto Banús and the historic charm of Marbella’s old town, each stop offers a unique and memorable experience. Don’t miss one of the Costa del Sol’s architectural gems: the stunning Colomares Castle in Benalmádena.

items.n: Explore Mijas and Marbella on a Day Trip from Malaga
items.d:
Discover the essence of the Costa del Sol on this full-day excursion to three must-see destinations: Mijas, Marbella, and Puerto Banus. Enjoy round-trip transportation from Malaga and free time at each stop to explore at your own pace.

We start in Marbella with 1 hour and 45 minutes of free time. Discover the Avenida del Mar, famous for Salvador Dalí’s sculptures, and explore the charming old town, seafront promenade, and picturesque squares.

Next, we head to Puerto Banus, where you'll have 45 minutes of free time to explore this exclusive marina, filled with luxury yachts, high-end shops, and lively cafes.

Finally, we visit Mijas for about 2 hours and 30 minutes, including entry to the CAC Museum to admire Dalí and Picasso collections, as well as the second-largest Picasso ceramic collection in Europe. You’ll have time for lunch and to explore this charming white village.

items.n: Frigiliana and Nerja : Caves included from Malaga and Costa del Sol
items.d:
Embark on an excursion to Nerja and Frigiliana from the Costa del Sol and Malaga. We will start with the pick-up at the established points, and after touring the Costa del Sol, we will reach Frigiliana, a picturesque white village. For 11⁄2 hours you will have free time to stroll through its narrow streets, enjoy its panoramic viewpoints and explore the local craft market in the Three Cultures Square.

From Frigiliana, we will travel to Nerja, famous for its impressive Nerja Caves. You will have 2 hours of free time to explore the center of Nerja, famous for the Balcony of Europe and the replica of the boat ‘La Dorada’ of the ‘Blue Summer’ series. Then we will head to the Caves of Nerja where you will enjoy a guided tour with audio guide that lasts about 60 minutes

items.n: Private tour Catamaran Benalmádena: Dolphins, Cava & Fishing
items.d:
Enjoy ultimate exclusivity at sea with a catamaran dedicated solely to your group. Celebrate with 2 complimentary bottles of cava while searching for dolphins and cruising along the beautiful Benalmádena coastline.

You will have total freedom to swim, use our paddleboards, go snorkeling, or try your luck with our fishing gear. Additionally, you are welcome to bring your own food and drinks from home to make yourself feel right at home on your private yacht. Total privacy and relaxation for a maximum of 12 people!

items.n: Malaga Highlights: Private & Customizable Tour
items.d: Explore Malaga at your own pace on this 4-hour private sightseeing ride with an English-speaking driver. After pickup from your hotel or apartment, enjoy local insights, personal recommendations, and photo stops along the way. Customize your itinerary with highlights such as the Alcazaba, Malaga Cathedral, Ataranzas Market, Parque de Malaga, and the Museo Picasso. Stroll through Plaza del Siglo, and enjoy sweeping city views from Mirador del Gibralfaro. After your tour, your driver will drop you off at your accommodation for a smooth and relaxed finish.

items.n: Alcazaba Malaga Guided Tour
items.d:
Surely the most representative monument of the city. To penetrate this Arab palace, is to penetrate the heart of Malaga, it is impossible to understand Malaga's history without visiting it.

Witness the invincible power of the Alcazaba! Extensive views of the sea, beautiful details of Muslim architecture, relaxing fountains and gardens…. There are many things to discover that will leave you breathless.

Visit the Alcazaba of Malaga while our guides explain how the Muslims lived, how the palace worked and some of the hidden legends of this ancient place.

In addition, the visit can be made in other languages (German, French and Italian), checking the availability of the day in advance.

items.n: Sunset on Private Sailing boat Puerto Banus Marbella (10 pax)
items.d: Get to know the coast of Marbella and the Golden Mile in a unique and very relaxing way: sailing while the sunset, on a private sailboat. You will toast with a bottle of Cava while you watch the last rays of sun disappear on the horizon. With the possibility of bathing in the sea.

items.n: Near Malaga: Mijas Organic Vineyard, 5 Wines, 2 Oils & Tapas
items.d: Visit an organic vineyard and olive grove in the hills above Mijas for a relaxed 2.5-hour small-group tasting. Begin with an approximately 25-minute walk around the vineyard and country house, learning about organic cultivation and the local project. Then taste 5 organic wines and 2 family-produced organic extra virgin olive oils—picual and arbequina—with Málaga cheeses, Iberian cured meats, Spanish tortilla, local olives and snacks. The experience is hosted in English for adults aged 18+, with a maximum of 16 participants. Transport is not included; guests meet directly at the vineyard. The venue is wheelchair accessible. Sessions run Monday to Saturday mornings and Monday to Friday evenings, subject to live availability.

items.n: Guided King’s Way without Transportation
items.d: Enjoy a guided walking route through the impressive Gaitanes Gorge, over 100 meters high. This tour runs along the famous path of the Caminito del Rey, considered one of the most spectacular in the world. Live an unforgettable experience in a unique natural environment, full of adventure and breathtaking landscapes. Along the way, you will be able to observe the local fauna, including majestic lion vultures that fly over the area. Ideal for lovers of nature and excitement.

items.n: Guided Tour to Caminito del Rey from Malaga
items.d:
We will start the tour with pick-up with transport at an agreed starting point.
We will visit Caminito del Rey accompanied by a local guide. 
The Caminito del Rey consists of 7,7 kms between walkways and trails crossing at the end of the route over a 105 mts high suspension bridge over the Desfiladero de los Gaitanes.

We will return to the meeting point to resume the return trip.

items.n: Explore Seville at Your Own Pace from Malaga
items.d:
Join us on a day trip to Seville! We’ll pick you up from your chosen meeting point, and as you enjoy the Andalusian landscape, our guide will share fascinating facts about Seville.

Upon arrival, you'll have 5 hours of free time to explore the city at your own pace. Start at the impressive Plaza de España, then wander through the historic center, where you can admire the Seville Cathedral and Giralda from the outside, along with the gardens and architecture of the Royal Alcazar. Stroll through the charming Santa Cruz neighborhood, discover artisan shops, and enjoy traditional Andalusian tapas in lively plazas.

Once your free time is up, meet your guide to return comfortably to Malaga and your pick-up point.

A perfect excursion to experience the best of Seville in one day—no rush, just at your own pace!

items.n: Caminito del rey Entrance tickets and guided tour
items.d:
Located in the center of Andalusia, Spain, the Caminito del Rey stands out as one of the most exhilarating and picturesque walking paths in the region. Stretching roughly 7 kilometers through the Desfiladero de los Gaitanes gorge, this trail provides stunning vistas, a deep historical background, and an unforgettable experience for every visitor.

This guide offers all the crucial information necessary for planning your trip to the Caminito del Rey, including specifics on the trail, ticketing options, access points, accommodations, dining establishments, and nearby attractions.
The Caminito del Rey transcends the typical hiking experience; it presents an adventure that merges natural splendor, historical fascination, and exhilarating heights. Whether you are in search of a tranquil stroll through nature, a historical exploration, or a thrilling escapade, the Caminito del Rey fulfills all these desires.

items.n: Private Luxury Yacht Charter from PUERTO BANÚS, Marbella
items.d:
Embark on an unforgettable experience from the exclusive Puerto Banús aboard Dakota, a magnificent 13.5-meter yacht. 
During the cruise, we’ll sail along the Costa del Sol in search of dolphins, while you enjoy breathtaking views from the sea.

On board, you can relax on the spacious sun deck, soak up the sun, and enjoy water activities like paddleboarding or snorkeling. 
The yacht is equipped with a high-quality Bluetooth sound system, you can play your favorite music and set the perfect vibe — ideal for celebrating birthdays, bachelor/bachelorette parties, or simply enjoying a different kind of day at sea.

The perfect plan to disconnect, relax, and experience the Mediterranean in total comfort.

Join us for an unforgettable day at sea — we’ll be waiting for you!

items.n: RONDA and SETENIL from Nerja, Torrox, and Torre del Mar
items.d:
Join a day trip to Ronda and Setenil de las Bodegas, one of Spain’s most picturesque and historic towns. 

Relax on a comfortable ride first to Setenil de las Bodegas and then to Ronda. Along the journey, our guide will share fascinating details about the region’s history, culture, and the top things to see and do.

In Setenil de las Bodegas, get on the tourist train to the village centre; where you’ll have one hour to explore it at your own pace. Stroll through its famous streets where houses are built into the cliffs, enjoy some time in one of the cave-side bars, or simply wander around the whitewashed alleys.

In Ronda, you will have 3 hours of free time to explore this breathtaking city at your own pace. Stroll through the charming streets, visit the legendary Puente Nuevo for breathtaking views over El Tajo Gorge, or visit the Plaza de Toros, one of Spain’s oldest bullrings. Whether you're a history lover, a foodie, or a nature enthusiast, Ronda offers something for everyone.

items.n: Caminito del Rey with Pickup from Nerja, Torrox and Torre del Mar
items.d:
Choose your closest pick-up location from Nerja, Torrox, or Torre del Mar.
Relax aboard a Premium Bus with air conditioning on our way to the Caminito del Rey day trip. 
Listen as your guide who speaks German, and English, tells you about the surroundings and history. 
At the beginning of the hike, you will receive a fresh bottle of water. Feel the thrill of walking above the Guadalhorce River from the north access point and make your way for approximately 2 .5 hours at your own pace and have time to take photos of the landscape along the route and admire the beauty of the Gaitanes Gorge.
At the end of the hike, you´ll get together with your guide again and the bus will pick you up, enjoy and relax on the way back to your starting point.

items.n: Frigiliana and Nerja Tour from Costa del Sol
items.d: Visit the quaint Spanish villages of Frigiliana and Nerja on this half-day tour from Costa del Sol. Admire the whitewashed houses and medieval Moorish fortress in Frigiliana, offering panoramic Mediterranean views, and amble through the meandering alleyways in nearby Nerja, perched on the coast. Enjoy comfortable coach transport and free time to explore at your own pace.

items.n: Parasailing Benalmadena - The Highest Flights on the Costa
items.d:
Soar safely above the sea with a parasailing experience provided by a British-run company that has been operating water sports in Fuengirola for over 30 years. Experience the rush of reaching heights of 650ft on this action-packed trip. 

Enjoy a secure experience with an activity provider that is endorsed by the EPPA (European Professional Parasailing Association), Europe's leading parasailing training organization.

Take off from the shore on a comfortable winch boat and enjoy views of the shore. Get set up with high-quality parasailing equipment that is maintained to the highest safety standards. Fly alone or with your friends and family, as up to 6 people can fly together.

Marvel at uninterrupted views of the popular city of Benalmadena & Puerto Marina. Gaze out at the beaches and turquoise waters of Benalmadena. Return to your starting point at the end of your trip.

items.n: Sunset Experience from Benalmadena
items.d: Unlike a conventional boat trip, this departure is made aboard Costasol Cruise ships, spacious ships with wide decks, bar and professional sound equipment on both floors. You will enjoy the sunset over the Alboran Sea with a welcome cocktail included and a cared atmosphere, ideal for both couples and families and groups. We are a local company with Blue Flag badge, committed to responsible navigation and accessibility on board, ensuring a safe, comfortable and respectful experience with the marine environment.

items.n: Benalmadena Catamaran : Dolphins, Tapas and Sea Baths 2hrs. 30min.
items.d:
Enjoy a unique catamaran sailing experience on the Costa del Sol, ideal for those looking to combine relaxation, gastronomy and nature. During the crossing, you can taste a selection of Spanish tapas prepared with local ingredients, for your Tasting while taking in breathtaking views of the coastline.

One of the most special moments will be the sighting of dolphins in their natural habitat, an unforgettable opportunity to connect with marine life. In addition, we will make a stop so you can take a refreshing swim in the sea and enjoy the surroundings.

Perfect for couples, families or friends, this excursion offers an ideal combination of adventure and rest. Book now and live an unforgettable experience at sea!

items.n: Mijas Mountains Buggy Tour, Costa del Sol 2 hours
items.d: This tour gives you the opportunity for a full off-roading experience. We take you on a journey into the Sierra de Mijas Mountains where we drive through dirt tracks, cross river beds and take a stop at a mountain viewpoint.

items.n: Private 4-hour walking tour of Malaga with official tour guide
items.d: Enjoy this completely private walking 4-hour tour of Málaga and explore the city’s most iconic places. Since the inauguration of the Picasso museum in 2003, the city has been enjoying a rebirth of it's cultural life. Malaga has hosted different cultures, from the romans, to the moors, to the beeing nowadays one of the most important cities of Andalucia. Visit the cathedral of Malaga, known as "la manquita".

items.n: Via Ferrata Caminito del Rey
items.d: This activity takes place in a unique environment, surrounded by rugged mountains and lakes. An adventure in nature full of sensations which highlights the zip line of more than 30 meters and the 2 cable bridges over the void.

items.n: Malaga Private Gastronomic Tour: Tapas, Wine & Rooftops
items.d: Indulge in the flavors of Southern Spain on this guided tapas and wine tour through Malaga’s old town. Enjoy different selected stops at traditional restaurants and local wineries, each paired with exquisite regional wines. This perfect blend of gastronomy, history, and entertainment welcomes both visitors and locals, offering a chance to taste the exquisite tapas and enjoy fine drinks in some privileged locations, providing a comprehensive overview of the gastronomy of Spain and Malaga.

items.n: Ronda and Setenil Winery Tour from Costa del Sol
items.d:
We will visit one of the most beautiful and original villages in the province of Malaga with caves that were populated more than 5,000 years ago. We will also visit the most in demand town in the province of Málaga, Ronda. A city located on a deep gorge (the Tagus), which separates the new 15th century city from the old town, dating back to the time of Arab rule. 
We will enjoy the visit to the bullring of the 18th century, the New Bridge and the viewpoints, among other places to highlight the visit to the city of Ronda. 
Tuesdays DO NOT INCLUDE TICKETS TO PLAZA DE TOROS

items.n: Malaga Nightlife Pub Crawl Tour with Drinks and Clubs Entry
items.d:
The only original Nightlife Tour - Pub Crawl in Malaga. The best way to meet other travellers and enjoy local bars and clubs. A local guide will be there with you all the time to suggest the best and most typical drinks, apart from the ones included.

Please keep in mind that although the guides speak multiple languages, this tour is aimed at travelers from all over the world, and usually the preferred communication language is English.

Dressing code: No flip flops, sport shorts, tank top (for men) and swimming suit.

items.n: Tangier Private Day Trip from Tarifa or Malaga with Camel Ride
items.d:
Looking for a unique adventure just a short ride from Spain? Hop across the Strait of Gibraltar and step into a whole new world with our unforgettable Tangier day trip from Tarifa.
In just under an hour by ferry, you’ll arrive in vibrant Tangier, Morocco — where Europe and Africa meet in a fusion of culture, history, and charm. Explore the lively medina with a local guide, wander through colorful souks, visit historic landmarks like the Kasbah and the Sultan’s Palace, and enjoy panoramic views of the city and coastline.

items.n: Alhambra and Granada Private Daytrip from Nerja
items.d:
Want to explore the Alhambra without the crowds and with your own private guide? This private day trip from Nerja is just the way to do it — comfortably, smoothly, and with plenty of time to enjoy Granada too.

Your private driver will pick you up at your accommodation and take you straight to Granada. There, your local guide will meet you for a private, skip-the-line tour of the Alhambra, including the stunning Nasrid Palaces, the Generalife gardens, and the Alcazaba fortress. It’s history, beauty, and magic — all in one place.

After the tour, you’ll have about 3 hours of free time to explore the city your way. Wander through the charming Albaicín neighborhood, grab some tapas, or do a bit of shopping downtown.

At the end of the day, your driver will take you back to Nerja — relaxed, inspired, and probably already planning your next trip.

items.n: Best of Malaga and White Coastal Villages Private Tour
items.d: Discover the best of Málaga and its beautiful surroundings on this private tour combining history, culture, stunning views, and authentic Andalusian charm. Explore iconic landmarks, charming white villages, and the Mediterranean coastline with a knowledgeable local guide. Enjoy a relaxed and personalized experience designed to help you experience Málaga like a true local. Book now for an unforgettable journey on the Costa del Sol.

items.n: Horse and Flamenco Show in Malaga with Dinner
items.d:
At Club Hípico El Ranchito, you can enjoy Andalusian Night, consisting of the equestrian show Ritmo a Caballo, dinner and a flamenco show. A show you can't miss. We assure you, you've never seen anything like it. 

Programme:

From 5:45 p.m. to 7:30 p.m.: Ritmo a Caballo show
7:30 p.m.: End of show and transfer* to the restaurant to continue the evening.
7:45 p.m.: Arrival at the restaurant located 5 minutes from the equestrian centre.
From 8:00 p.m. to 9:00 p.m.: Dinner accompanied by traditional Andalusian music.
9:00 p.m.: Live Flamenco show with 4 artists (approx. 50 min)
10:00 p.m.: End of programme

* The restaurant is approximately 4 km away by car.

MENU consisting of cream of courgette soup, pork in sauce, Andalusian chicken skewers, fried potatoes and salad. 
Seasonal dessert, no choice.

(Alternatives available for vegetarians, vegans, coeliacs, Muslims and others on request and subject to confirmation)

Optional: guided tour of the stables at 5 pm

items.n: Malaga : Private Custom Walking Tour with A Guide (Private Tour)
items.d:
Malaga’s vibrant streets and coastal charm can sometimes feel like a maze for first-time visitors. Take the guesswork out of your trip by exploring with a local on a private walking tour. 
This personalized tour allows you to discover the exterior of monuments, including museums, while learning about the city’s history and culture. If you wish to include a museum visit, your guide can customize the itinerary to fit your interests—just let us know in advance. 
Your guide contacts you beforehand to understand your preferences, ensuring you see the places you truly want to experience. Perfect for families, solo travelers, or couples, this tour uncovers Malaga’s cultural gems and hidden spots.

items.n: Alcazaba and Gibralfaro Private Tour
items.d:
This tour stands out for its in-depth guided visit to the Alcazaba of Málaga, the main highlight of the experience, led by a specialist in Moorish art and Islamic architecture. Travelers enjoy detailed explanations of its history, palatial areas and Nasrid-style details, offering a deep understanding of this exceptional fortress.
For those choosing the 2-hour option, the tour continues to Gibralfaro Castle, with a scenic uphill walk and stunning panoramic views over Málaga and the Mediterranean, combined with expert insight into its strategic and historical importance.
A rich cultural experience focused on quality, authenticity and expert storytelling.

items.n: MANGO 5m 5pax - Unlicensed boat in Puerto Banus, Marbella
items.d:
Very comfortable and spacious boat for 5 people maximum, with stereo (bluetooth), probe, solarium, bathing ladder, fridge with ice, and awning. Drinks included!

Enjoy your friends and family sharing an unforgettable moment. It is also possible to see dolphins in the sea. A unique experience in a place like Puerto Banus in Marbella.

items.n: Private Eco Tuk Tuk Malaga Express Tour with Local Guide
items.d:
Eco Tuk Tuk offers you a trip through the city of Malaga. A contact with this city on the Costa del Sol, known for its mix of ancient history, folklore and modern culture. It’s a perfect way to get an idea of everything you can enjoy in the city on your travel days. And also the best possible photo tour for the traveler.

 - Discover the icons of Malaga such as Gibralfaro Castle and the Lamppost without getting tired walking.
 - Travel the city comfortably in a 100% eco-friendly electric tuk tuk.
 - Experience the history, folklore and modernity of Malaga on a fun and sustainable tour.

Make your stay in Malaga an unforgettable experience and take a great memory of this wonderful city!

items.n: Málaga Evening Tapas Crawl Tour by Food Lover Tour - All included
items.d:
This experience is a great way to really discover the culture through the local food and drinks and also by mixing with the crowd. Our expert guides are foodies willing to share their passion for food with you. The tour we have designed for you is a selection of some different venues that will give you a great overview of the great local places. With us you will visit places you would never have found by yourself and also taste some fresh and local products that many tourist don't know. All that, in the best atmosphere.

*Experience not adapted for vegetarians/vegans.
** Please contact us to let us know about any dietary restriction at the time of the your reservation.

items.n: Picasso Museum Malaga and Temporary Exhibitions Ticket
items.d: Step into the world of Pablo Picasso at the Picasso Museum Málaga, located in the artist’s birthplace and housed within the beautiful 16th-century Palacio de Buenavista. Explore an outstanding collection of more than 100 works that trace Picasso’s artistic evolution, from his early academic studies to the innovative styles that transformed modern art. Wander through galleries filled with paintings, sculptures, ceramics, drawings, and prints that reveal the creativity and vision of one of the 20th century’s most influential artists. Enhance your visit with an audio guide that provides deeper insight into Picasso’s life, techniques, and inspirations. You can also access temporary exhibitions showcasing additional masterpieces and unique perspectives on art. Whether you are an art enthusiast or a first-time visitor, this museum offers an inspiring journey through Picasso’s legacy and a memorable cultural experience in the heart of Málaga.

items.n: Alhambra and Albaicin Private Day Trip from Malaga
items.d:
Join this private day trip to the city of Granada and discover the Alhambra fort and the historic Albaicin neighborhood. Explore the enormous Alhambra and learn about its history and art at this UNESCO World Heritage site, Spain's most visited landmark. Visit the King's tomb, the Old Moorish market, and the secret and charming Albaicín. 

Be amazed by the innovative water features and architecture of the Generalife gardens. Learn about the symbols and techniques utilized in the monument's creation while admiring the magnificent chambers and Moorish architecture. Learn about the palace's different occupants over the centuries.

Discover Albaicín, Granada’s historic area which is filled with whitewashed homes, historic churches, and flower-filled balconies. Admire the Moorish architecture in the district of Albaicín and discover houses erected as Nasrid aristocrats' dwellings in the 14th and 15th centuries. Learn all about this historic district and its monumental surroundings.

items.n: Caminito del Rey Private Tour with Expert Guide
items.d:
Join a guided expedition along the Caminito del Rey, a remarkable one-way pathway nestled in Malaga's stunning natural setting.

Enjoy the most complete and comfortable way to experience El Caminito del Rey, one of the most spectacular hiking routes in southern Spain. Walk along breathtaking footbridges suspended more than 100 meters above the Gaitanes Gorge, accompanied by an official local guide who will bring the history, nature, and engineering of this unique place to life.

items.n: Private Day Trip to Ronda from Malaga with Driver-Guide
items.d:
Discover the charm of Ronda on a private full-day excursion from Malaga.

Forget crowded buses—this tailor-made experience is designed for you. Travel in comfort with your driver-guide and explore one of Spain’s most breathtaking towns at your own pace.

Highlights:

Scenic Andalusian Drive – Rolling hills, vineyards, and olive groves.

Puente Nuevo Bridge – Iconic span over El Tajo gorge.

Historic Old Town – Cobblestone streets & Moorish charm.

Plaza de Toros – One of Spain’s oldest bullrings.

Flexibility – Stop for photos, tapas, or coffee whenever you like.

This tour is 100% private – no strangers, no waiting, no rigid schedules. Enjoy extra time for wine tasting, a leisurely lunch, or a quick overview of the highlights—your day, your way.

✅ Hotel pickup/drop-off (Málaga, Marbella, Costa del Sol)
✅ Private driver-guide for a personal experience

Make your Andalusian trip unforgettable with this unique Ronda adventure.

items.n: Private Tour of Essential Malaga
items.d:
Explore Malaga with our exclusive 2 or 3-hour (choose your option) private tour!

 Starting at Constitution Square, we'll wander through Marques de Larios Street and discover the Cathedral of Malaga(EXTERIOR), known for its unfinished South Tower, fondly dubbed "the one-armed lady." Our journey continues through San Agustin Street, home to the Picasso Museum, and includes a visit to the iconic "El Pimpi" winery. 

Highlights also encompass the Roman Theater, Alcazaba of Malaga(tickets included), and the Malaga Museum, where Pablo Ruiz Picasso was born. Enjoy the city's rich history and culture in a brief yet immersive experience.

Only the 2-hour city tour and the 3-hour city tour with the Cathedral are accessible for individuals with reduced mobility or those using wheelchairs.

The 3-hour tour that includes the Alcazaba is not adapted due to the monument's conditions, both in terms of access and within the site itself.

items.n: Museum Picasso guided tour
items.d: Discover the work of one the best artists of the twentieth century: the local Pablo Ruiz Picasso. The museum is situated in the Palace of the Counts of Buenavista, Renaissance-style building, opened to public in 2003, hiding a roman house inside.

items.n: Shared Experience. Sunset Sailing Puerto Banus
items.d:
Sail sunset along the Marbella coast on a real sailboat.

We leave from Puerto Banus in a small group of up to 9 people, with a licensed captain who knows this coast by heart. While the sky is tinged with gold and pink, we sail in front of the Golden Mile with La Concha in the background — on clear days you can tell the difference to the North African coast.

Keep an eye on the water : dolphins are common in this area
 (never guaranteed, but it's part of the magic). When the sea does
Allows, we stop for a swim before toasting with a glass of cava
while the sun goes down.

Ideal for couples, friends or a quiet celebration — with toilet to
on board, Bluetooth speaker for your music, and the attention of a team
small and close.

Requires a minimum of 2 passengers. Warranty for bad weather: 
We reschedule your departure at no cost or refund 100%.

items.n: Mijas Mountains Buggy Tour, Costa del Sol 1 Hour
items.d: A great way to get a taste of the exhilarating off roading experience. We take you on a journey into the Sierra de Mijas Mountains where we drive through dirt tracks, cross river beds and take a stop at a mountain view point.

items.n: Marbella And Gibraltar Direct from Malaga Central
items.d:
Unlike many excursions to Gibraltar, this experience combines the visit to Marbella and Gibraltar in the same day, optimizing the maximum time thanks to a motorway tour and without the numerous usual pickups along the Costa del Sol.

The excursion includes a stop in Marbella, where you can enjoy free time to stroll through its charming old town, discover the Plaza de los Naranjos or enjoy the atmosphere of one of the most exclusive cities in Andalusia.

In Gibraltar you will have enough time to choose how to live the experience. You can explore the city at your own pace, tour Main Street and its shops, take the famous Rock Tour visiting Europa Point, San Miguel Cave and Gibraltar Monkeys, or embark on an exciting dolphin-watching activity at large.

A perfect combination of comfort, flexibility and quality time in two unique southern European destinations.

items.n: Cathedral Malaga : Ticket + Self-Guided Tour created by Official Guide
items.d:
With this tour you will be able to discover the secrets of Malaga Cathedral, the Renaissance jewel of the city. 

Designed by Yolanda, Official City Guide, this tour will accompany you as you discover the histories and curiosities of Malaga’s most important religious construction. 

With audio narrated by herself and images, you’ll live as complete an experience as if you were accompanied in person, but with the freedom to have all the information and a map on your mobile. 

INSTRUCTIONS for activating the tour and RECEIVING ENTRY to the Cathedral will arrive after purchase both by message and at the entrance of Viator.

The chosen timetable is subject to the final availability of Malaga Cathedral.

TICKETS ARE NOT THE VIATOR PURCHASE TICKET. YOU WILL RECEIVE THEM THE DAY BEFORE THE VISIT BY EMAIL.

items.n: Malaga Essential PRIVATE TOUR in Electric Tuktuk 2h
items.d:
Are you looking to see Malaga in style, without fatigue and in an eco-friendly way? Get on TukandFlow. In 120 min. we connect the ancient essence of this city with the most cutting edge part in the 100% electric Tuktuk. Forget the massive buses and live the city at your own pace!

Your VIP route: 
 Picasso's cradle: We will visit the Plaza de la Merced, where the genius was born.
 Views of Infarct : We climbed to Gibralfaro Castle. The best 360° panorama without sweating a drop!
️ Elegance: We will pass through the City Hall, the Bullring and the vibrant Atarazanas Market.
 Alma Marinera : Breeze in Malagueta and walk through the picturesque neighborhood of Pedregalejo.
 Malaga Modern : Must-see photo in the Cube of the Pompidou and La Farola of the port.

Why us?
 Private : Just you and yours.
 Eco-Friendly : No noise or smoke.
 VIP access: We get where others can't.

Malaga has a special flow, discover it with us! Book your place now!

items.n: Private 12-Seater Catamaran Charter in Benalmádena
items.d: Chartering a Lagoon 410 catamaran in Benalmádena is ideal for enjoying memorable moments with family and friends. This spacious catamaran, with capacity for 12 people plus a captain and crew member, combines luxury and comfort. Sail the waters of Málaga while enjoying activities such as snorkeling, dolphin watching, and more.

items.n: Ronda & Setenil de las Bodegas, land of contrasts /Semi-private
items.d:
A unique experience departing from Malaga in a Semi-Private group (maximum 8 travellers) in which we will discover all the secrets of Sentenil de las Bodegas and Ronda. Land of bandits, rich flavors, all wrapped in a truly unique and different environment and accompanied throughout the tour by an Official Guide.

This experience will take us through places as striking for their own nature as for their history, leaving us with some images that we will never forget. Land of bandits, rich flavors, in a truly unique and different environment.

Departing from Malaga, we will go deep into the province until we reach Setenil de las Bodegas, in the province of Cadiz. Its shapes will immediately catch our attention, places as iconic as the Calle Cueva de las Sombras or the Calle del Sol, among others.

We return to Malaga to reach Ronda. Imposing, full of history and legends. While we lose ourselves in its narrow streets, we will discover the history of such outstanding places as the New Bridge of Ronda, and the striking House of the Moorish King.

items.n: Flamenco, Tapas and Wine Tour: Best of Málaga in one Evening
items.d:
After the success of our Traditional Wine and Tapas Tour, now we are offering the best of Málaga in one single evening: history, gastronomy, local wines, culture, and art in an awesome tour where we will explain everything you want to know! 

We'll find out how and where locals love to share their time with friends in front of a little glass of wine and some tapas! In the traditional way :) Together with your lovely guide, you'll visit 3 different taverns or wine cellars in the city center.

We’ll accompany you to the entrance of the Flamenco Show and there, we’ll make sure you enjoy the best Flamenco in a private atmosphere!

We said it before, this is the most complete experience to get to know the Best of Málaga in only One Evening!

items.n: Malaga 2 Hours E-Bike Tour with Gibralfaro Forest
items.d: Discover Málaga’s most iconic sights on a comfortable e-bike — from hilltop views at Mount Gibralfaro to the lively port and historic old town. Enjoy insider stories, scenic coastal paths, and plenty of photo stops in just 2 hours!

items.n: Malaga Highlights by Electric Car with Port Pick up
items.d:
Discover Málaga in a fun, unique, and sustainable way with our guided tour by electric car. Experience the thrill of DRIVIING YOUR OWN VEHICLE, DRIVE YOURSELF! while following our local guide, who will be nearby at all times to ensure an unforgettable adventure.

During the tour, you’ll enjoy carefully selected stops at Málaga’s most iconic landmarks, including the stunning Gibralfaro Castle viewpoint, where breathtaking panoramic views await you. Our guide will share fascinating stories about the city’s culture, history, and hidden gems, all while you travel in the comfort of a 100% electric and eco-friendly car.

Important Information:

Drivers must be over 25 years old and hold a valid driver’s license.
Co-pilots are welcome from the age of 3, making this tour ideal for couples, friends, and families.

Don’t miss the chance to experience Málaga in an authentic and memorable way. We can’t wait to share this unique adventure with you!

items.n: Guided tour of Castillo Colomares
items.d:
The Colomares Castle is a unique monument on the Costa del Sol. Built at the end of the 20th century, here we are told the story of Christopher Columbus' first trip to America.
In this tour we help you to read this magnificent book made in stone and to decipher all the symbols found here.

items.n: Gibraltar and Mijas Tour from Málaga full assistance
items.d:
Leave Málaga and hit the Strait faster via autopista—less time on the bus, more in Gibraltar. 

Enjoy ~5h15 minutes of free time: Travel to the Top of the Rock, visit St. Michael’s Cave and the Great Siege Tunnels, or shop Main Street. 

Then swap sea views for whitewashed Mijas Pueblo with ~1h15 minutes to explore plazas, artisan shops and viewpoints. 

Return to Málaga at your original pick-ups.

Highlights

-Full-day coach tour with Spanish/English host

-Express highway for a smoother, quicker day

-Free time in both Gibraltar (~5:15h) and Mijas (~1.15h)

-Convenient Málaga pick-up points

-Departures from Gibraltar and Mijas: The bus will wait up to 5 minutes at each stop. Latecomers will not be waited for.

 Important:
Bring a valid passport (or ID if EU/EEA/Swiss).
Gibraltar is not in Schengen — a visa may be required depending on your nationality. Please check.

items.n: Canyoning Rio Verde from Nerja
items.d:
We are a team who has over 10 year of experience in adventure tourisme.
I am a qualified technician in hiking, climbing and canyoning. I am a happy and communicative person. I love teaching Andalusian nature, culture and traditions by applying group dynamics games and environmental knowledge.

items.n: LA Almazara Olive Oil and Tasting with Audio Guide
items.d:
The mill designed by Philippe Starck stands as the first author mill in the world, fusing tradition, modernity and gastronomy in one place: the Sierra de Ronda. This space has been designed to highlight the culture and history of one of the emblematic products of Spanish gastronomy, with the collaboration of Philippe Starck, noted international designer.

LA Almazara allows you to witness firsthand the process of growing and transforming olive oil into an avant-garde building that has its own museum, tasting areas or auditorium for events in an incomparable place, the Sierra de Ronda. The building is a unique architectural gem, with a structure inspired by the personality of Andalusia: austere, rigorous, real, exaggerated, timeless, strong, spiritual and passionate.

items.d:

items.n: Frigiliana and Nerja Tour from Malaga
items.d: Set off from Malaga and enjoy the fresh ocean air on this tour to the Spanish towns of Frigiliana and Nerja. Sit back and enjoy the Mediterranean scenery from an air-conditioned coach, and visit Frigiliana to admire its whitewashed houses, see the Moorish fortress and shop for local pottery and wine.

items.n: Malaga City Tour 3 Hour Historical Segway Adventure
items.d:
Discover the essence of Malaga on our 3-hour historical city tour, where you’ll explore iconic landmarks, uncover fascinating history, and enjoy breathtaking views. Whether you're a history buff, art lover, or just looking for a unique adventure, this tour offers a comprehensive exploration of Malaga’s cultural gems.

What Sets This Tour Apart:
Comprehensive Exploration: Experience more than just a Segway ride; immerse yourself in the full breadth of Malaga’s history and culture.
Expert Storytelling: Our guides bring Malaga’s history to life with engaging stories and insights, making each stop memorable.
All-Age Friendly: Ideal for families, solo travelers, and groups looking for an enriching city adventure.
Eco-Friendly Travel: Explore sustainably, reducing your carbon footprint while enjoying the thrill of a Segway.

items.n: Malaga The Ultimate Flamenco Tapas Tour
items.d: Indulge in the passionate rhythms of flamenco and the exquisite flavors of Malaga's culinary delights on our captivating Flamenco and Food Tour

items.n: Visit Seville’s Real Alcázar on a Day Trip from Malaga
items.d:
Book an exciting excursion from Malaga and immerse yourself in the rich history of Seville, visiting the breathtaking Royal Alcazar. Explore this dreamlike palace, with its exquisite gardens and unique architecture. Experience the grandeur of Andalusian culture as you stroll through its majestic halls and courtyards. From the stunning tiles to the intricate architectural details, every corner tells a fascinating story.

Our expert guide will reveal the secrets of this UNESCO World Heritage site, giving you a deeper understanding of its history. After the tour, you'll have time to enjoy Seville's lively atmosphere and beauty.

Book now and let the charm of Seville envelop you, while exploring one of the city’s most iconic treasures. Don't miss out on the chance to create unforgettable memories at the Royal Alcázar!

items.n: Fun, fast, flamenco: learn to dance flamenco rumba in 45 minutes
items.d:
Premium & Personalized Experience: This workshop is designed for individuals and very small groups to guarantee personal attention, high technical quality, and a truly authentic flamenco experience. 
Perfect for solo travelers, friends, and special celebrations. 
Special Summer Edition: This season, we are learning a magical and iconic Rumba that is deeply embedded in the history and culture of Spain. If you want to discover its secrets and feel its rhythm, book your spot and join our class!
After this class you will feel full of energy, good spirits and happiness.
The place of the class is in the center of Málaga; is very easy to find.
It is recommended to come to the class with comfortable sports clothes. Women can wear shoes with small heels.
The class is very easy to follow. 
This class is also very good for health. It greatly improves blood circulation and relaxes the muscles or the whole body. Enjoy it a lot.

items.n: Malaga - guided horseback riding
items.d:
A great opportunity to disconnect with routine and connect with nature.

The privileged location of our equestrian center allows us to offer the possibility of organizing horse riding routes surrounded by an unbeatable landscape.

An unforgettable experience, without a doubt, in which you can enjoy nature for 1 hour on horseback.

ENJOY THIS UNIQUE EXPERIENCE!
You will have a tourist guide, a docile and friendly horse.

items.n: Via Ferrata El Caminito del Rey El Chorro with professional guide
items.d:
The Via Ferrata El Chorro – Caminito del Rey is located in the Natural Site of the Gaitanes Gorge, in Alora, Malaga. Surrounded by stunning gorges, it is one of Europe’s most iconic areas for climbing and adventure. No previous experience is needed, only good physical condition and desire to live a unique experience.
Accompanied by specialized guides, you will enjoy a tour of about 4 hours with a K3 level, more demanding for its length than for its difficulty. The route includes a vertical ascent with iron steps, a 35-meter zip line, a 15-meter Tibetan bridge and a 30-meter mono bridge, with spectacular views of the Enchanted Reservoir and the surroundings of Caminito del Rey. The descent is made by a small trekking that allows to contemplate the famous stone bridge under the train tracks and the natural wealth of the environment. It is carried out in small groups to ensure security and personalized attention.

items.n: Paramotor flight in Ronda
items.d:
The flight in Paratrike offers the great advantage that it is accessible to all regardless of the physical condition you have, since you do not need to run, just sit back and enjoy the experience.

After giving some basic safety explanations, we will get on the paratrike, start the engine, inflate the paraglider, roll a few meters along the track and then fly off.

Once on the flight we take a little height and start our tourist route by air.

You do not need previous knowledge or any physical preparation, just wanting adventure, the rest is our team of professionals.

Come and enjoy with us the wonderful landscapes of the emblematic Ronda bridge, El Tajo.

It is a very safe activity, modern paragliders comply with a series of very strict safety approvals.

items.n: TopBuggy Ronda Gorge Discovery Experience
items.d:
IMPORTANT: Minimum drivers' age: 25. with at least 2 years drivers licence. Driver must meet BOTH conitions 
Discover the "Tajo de Ronda" or as in English: the Gorge, in a stunning 1:30 hour drive with top quality Can Am and Yamaha R-Max side-by-side vehicles with one of this operator's most popular guided, self-drive experiences. This is an impressive trip with as much offroad as possible, then through the old part of town and down to the Ronda Gorge with a stop for an an included soft drink or coffee. For longer experiences please check out our TopBuggy.es web as they are only available through direct reservation.

items.n: Malaga City Wine Tour
items.d:
Malaga's first on foot tour of artisan Spanish wines...
Experience 4 corners of Spain without leaving Malaga with this two hour tour of four wine hot spots in the historical centre.
As your personal wine guide walks and talks you through our journey you will learn a little history and a lot of fun facts about the wines we will enjoy. We have paired the wine with a delicious little snack to keep you fuelled up as we go. At each stop you will receive a glass of wine and a tapa whilst your guide tells you all about what's in your glass. Distance covered is around 700m but we will never have you walking more than 5 minutes between stops.This route is designed to show the diversity of Spanish wines and will include white, red & natural wines. The wines & snacks are set and cannot be adapted or changed. This trail is not suitable for anyone with food allergies or restrictions.

items.n: From Malaga : Seville Day Trip with Cathedral and Giralda Tickets
items.d:
Choose your pick-up point to begin an unforgettable tour of Seville. Enjoy panoramic views of the city as we pass iconic spots like Paseo de Colón, the Guadalquivir River, and Avenida de las Palmeras.

Our first stop is the stunning Maria Luisa Park, where you can explore the majestic Plaza de España, a true symbol of Seville. Then, we’ll wander through the charming narrow streets of the Historic Center, where history comes alive.

Next, enjoy a one-hour guided visit to Seville's impressive Cathedral, known for its unique architecture and the Giralda Tower, offering spectacular city views.

Afterward, you’ll have free time to continue exploring, visit the Torre del Oro, or stroll along the Guadalquivir River. Alternatively, explore the charming Triana neighborhood.

We'll meet at Puerta de Jerez for the return to the starting point.

items.n: Málaga Andalusian Wine Tasting: 5 Wines and Local Food
items.d: This is far more than a standard wine tasting: it is a fun, sensory journey designed to change the way you experience wine. In a welcoming small-group setting, explore five exceptional Andalusian wines with an expert host through playful experiments, surprising stories and simple techniques anyone can enjoy. Discover aromas and flavors you may never have noticed, compare impressions with the group, and enjoy premium Ibérico cured meats from Ronda and artisan Málaga cheeses along the way. Expect laughter, genuine local character and a few carefully planned surprises. Come for a memorable evening in Málaga; leave with new favorite wines and the confidence to enjoy every future glass more deeply.

items.n: Málaga: 1-Hour Flamenco Dance Class with a Spanish Teacher
items.d:
Discover just in 1 hour class whith a professional Spanish Teacher the funniest way to learn how to dance a flamenco choreography you will never forget.

It can be a private flamenco dance lesson just for you or you can enjoy it with a group to celebrate for instance your bridal shower.

After the class you will have the opportunity to enjoy the recording of the complete lesson, to keep practising and not forget what you learned.

items.n: Gibraltar Day Trip at your Own Pace from Malaga & Costa del Sol
items.d:
During the bus tour, you will enjoy a scenic journey along Málaga and the Costa del Sol, as our guide shares fascinating anecdotes and curiosities about Gibraltar, a British colony with a unique blend of history, culture, and traditions.

Upon arrival in La Línea, we will cross the border—remember to check your documentation to access Gibraltar. Once we arrive at the Gibraltar bus park, you will have the whole day to explore the city at your own pace. Visit Main Street, famous for its shops and cafés, and Casemates Square, where you’ll find local history and vibrant energy. Don’t miss the stunning Alameda Botanical Gardens, or take a stroll along Marina Bay. For beach lovers, Sandy Bay and Catalan Bay offer crystal-clear waters and breathtaking views. Explore the Mediterranean Steps, a hike that rewards you with spectacular panoramic views of the coastline and Gibraltar's famous Rock. 

At the designated time, we will meet with our guide to return to the pick-up point.

items.n: Torcal de Antequera Hiking Tour from Málaga
items.d: Have an amazing time on this hiking in Torcal de Antequera Natural Park (UNESCO site) during 3 hours. You will leave Malaga on a small group tour, up to 8 people and you will spend a magic day in this beautiful place.

items.n: Luxury Tangier Private Day Tour from Malaga All inclusive
items.d:
Morocco, country with rich history fascinating heritage, divers cuisine, traditions and unique nature will make you travel across footprints of ancient civilizations and their cultures. Tangier was governed under a unique and complex system that involved various European nations, the United States, and the Sultan of Morocco.

Drive along Costa del Sol coast in a luxury car and take an express ferry across the Strait of Gibraltar. Upon arrival immerse yourself into unique picture of Moroccan daily life. Meet your guide and explore the most beautiful and historic sites. Drive along the corniche towards the new city, pass by the Grand Mosque, Kings Palace, visit Herciles Caves and greet a camels on Achakkar beach.

Stop at the meeting point of the Mediterranean Sea and Atlantic Ocean and explore panoramic views in Paerdicaris park and Kasbah! Walk into the maze of small streets of medina and learn about history, cultureand learn about traditional costumes wander around colorful souks

items.n: Malaga Shore Excursion Costa del Sol Signature Escape
items.d:
This tour is ideal for travelers who want to enjoy the Costa del Sol without feeling rushed or lost in a large crowd.

Limited to just 20 guests, it offers a relaxed, more personal alternative to typical cruise ship excursions, with comfortable transportation and a carefully paced itinerary. You’ll enjoy a scenic introduction to Málaga and a beautiful coastal drive along the Costa del Sol before visiting Mijas, one of Andalusia’s most beautiful white villages, with flower-filled streets, Mediterranean views and local wine tasting.

Continue to Marbella for a guided walk through the charming Old Town, including Plaza de los Naranjos, hidden streets and the Dalí sculptures on Avenida del Mar. The day finishes in Puerto Banús, where luxury yachts, boutiques and waterfront cafés create a glamorous final stop.

With guided visits, local flavours and plenty of free time to chill, shop, take photos or explore, this is a complete Costa del Sol experience at an easy pace.

items.n: Alhambra Private Tour with pickup in Marbella or Malaga
items.d:
Experience the magic of this UNESCO World Heritage Site, where the echoes of centuries past resonate in every intricate detail.

Alhambra showcases the blending of Moorish and Renaissance influences, offering a glimpse into Spain's diverse cultural heritage. A fortress- palace first built by the Sultan of Granada in 1333.

Explore the Nasrid Palaces, Generalife Gardens, Alcazaba Fortress, and the Palace of Charles V, each contributing to the richness of this historical site.

Admire sweeping views of nearby villages and the jagged Sierra Nevada mountain range from within the Alhambra complex.

Gain a deeper understanding of the intricate details and historical narratives benefiting from the expertise of your tour guide.

Enjoy the convenience of hotel pickup, ensuring a seamless and comfortable start to your Alhambra experience. Relax and focus on the beauty that unfolds during the tour.

items.n: Private adventure Tour from Malaga to the Caminito del Rey
items.d:
The Caminito Del Rey private day trip from Malaga (King's little pathway) in El Chorro is probably one of the most exciting walking tours you will ever do. Closed to the public for the last 15 years, it is now once again open after a 5 million Euro restoration project.
The Caminito Del Rey featured recently in the lonely planet's top new travel experiences. It was once known as one of the world’s most dangerous hikes, but not anymore. Now the King's little pathway in El Chorro is safely open to all. 
The true attraction of the Caminito Del Rey is still there with awesome views and an amazing sense of naturalness of the spectacular rock walls, dazzlingly high walking ledges and breath-taking hanging bridge which will stay with you forever.
For those looking for an amazing experience along with spectacular views and something you will never experience again, then this is for you.

items.n: Guided tour of Ronda with an official guide
items.d:
This is a private visit, that is, the guide will be alone with his group.

You can customize your visit and tailor the two-hour tour to your preferences.

Our guides are as passionate about their job as Ronda is and it shows. We like to tell the story in an entertaining way, with the idea that travelers enjoy a pleasant experience.

Making this Ronda visit with us you will discover the most interesting places and you will learn about its history, the way of life, the customs and you will discover why so many illustrious people fell in love with the "Dream City" by Rainer María Rilke.

We want each client to feel like someone else from Ronda.
Because visiting is not the same as feeling.

items.n: Private day trip from Malaga to Ronda and Marbella, Local driver
items.d:
Embark on an enchanting private tour with your private driver, an expert long-distance driver, immersing yourself in breathtaking vistas, cultural treasures, and natural wonders. This journey promises unforgettable moments as you explore the world on your exclusive trip.

This private tour is a pleasant way to spend your time. It includes transportation from Malaga to sightseeing stops in Ronda, Marbella and back.

All this in the comfort of a private car with an English-speaking local driver who knows the area and will be happy to share information with you.

1 to 3 people, we will provide a sedan or combi.
4 people, we will provide an MPV.
5 to 7/8 people, we will provide a VAN.

If you prefer a larger vehicle and wish to ensure additional space during your trip, please choose a different number of travelers in the booking form according to this description.

Our drivers are friendly and available at all times. If you have any requirements, just let us know.

items.n: Creative Photo Workshop in Malaga - by OhMyGoodGuide
items.d:
We will discover the hidden of Málaga while showing you how to take the best pictures and make different compositions and quick editing and adjusting the color, light and contrasts. 

You'll discover that photography is an art open to everyone, you just have to learn some simple things and you'll start taking the most amazing shots!

items.n: Day Trip from Malaga to Gibraltar and Mijas by bus
items.d:
Join us on a full-day private excursion from Malaga to the iconic Rock of Gibraltar, exploring its fascinating history as a British colony since 1703. Blending British and Mediterranean cultures, Gibraltar is captivating.
PLEASE NOTE

items.n: Tour of Malaga Bullring & Bullfighting Museum with Audioguide
items.d:
- Visit the Malaga Bullring, an impressive monument of the city, located next to the harbour, with an audioguide in your language
- Discover its most secret places such as the ring, the bull pens, the infirmary or the chapel
- Visit the 6 immersive rooms of the permanent exhibition with art works, sculptures, paintings, suits of lights and interactive projections.
- Enjoy the bullfighting simulator or the 360º virtual reality experiences
- Discover the gift shop

items.n: Granada Full Day Tour From Malaga
items.d: Discover the beautiful city of Granada, in the foothills of Sierra Nevada Mountains. Enjoy a guided tour of Granada city center, you will have free time to savor some tasty tapas, visit the city on your own or whatever you prefer. Later on, explore with a guide the Alhambra Palace, the Palace of Charles V and the Generalife Gardens. You can also choose the “On Your Own” option to explore this wonderful city at your own pace.

items.n: Self Guided Cycling Adventure from Ronda to Setenil
items.d:
A 35km self-guided bike ride awaits, weaving through olive groves and vineyards before arriving at Setenil de las Bodegas, famed for its unique cliffside houses.

Collect your bike just outside Ronda and tackle an easy-to-moderate route with gradual ascents, culminating in a delightful downhill glide into the village. After exploring the stunning cave houses and indulging in some tapas, a quick shuttle returns you to Ronda. With included bike hire, GPS, support and transport, this hassle-free adventure allows you to immerse yourself in the beauty of the Andalusian landscape at your own pace.

items.n: Minibus Tour - White Villages (Grazalema and Zahara de la Sierra)
items.d: A driving tours with a native English-speaking driver to explore the beautiful landscape and white villages hidden in the Grazalema Natural Park near Ronda. This tour takes you on a scenic drive to visit two of the most popular white villages and mountain drives in the Ronda area. Tour lasts 3-4 hours, with plenty of time to enjoy the views, take photos and breathe in the atmosphere of the Andalucian countryside.

items.n: Malaga Fishing Experience with Equipment Food and Drinks Included
items.d:
What makes this experience unique is the personalized attention and relaxed atmosphere on board. Unlike crowded tours, offering small groups for a more exclusive and authentic fishing experience. Your local captain knows the best fishing spots in Malaga and adapts the trip to your level, whether you are a beginner or experienced.

All equipment, drinks, and snacks are included, so you don’t have to worry about anything—just enjoy the sea, the views, and the thrill of fishing. It’s not just a tour, it’s a real fishing experience in the Mediterranean.

Perfect for getting to know the beaches and coves of the coast, dolphin watching, snorkeling, swimming in the high seas, a romantic walk enjoying the sunset on the Costa del Sol and much more. of possibilities.
