Civil liability and crew insurance.
Safety equipment required by current regulations.
Obligatory deposit, mooring electricity and water in the base port included, cleaning included.

items.n: Caminito del Rey Small Group Tour from Malaga with Picnic
items.d:
We are the best way to discover Caminito del Rey avoiding the crowds and big groups.

We are the only tour that includes a picnic with local products.

Small group (8 people max.) with independent travelers. Lots of fun guaranteed.

Visit the Natural Park during the less busy hours.

The guide is an expert in geography and geology.

items.n: Mijas, Marbella and Banus Day Tour from Costa del Sol
items.d: Come and join us with this 9-hour tour departing from Costa del Sol (Malaga, Torremolinos, Fuengirola and Marbella) to discover the fantastic city of Marbella, located on the Mediterranean shore between Malaga and the Strait of Gibraltar. Take the chance to walk along the Marbella's streets where you will be able to see its many fashion boutiques and to meet its famous jet set.

items.n: Private Transfer from Malaga airport (AGP) to Marbella
items.d: Take the worry out of your arrival to Malaga Airport and pre-book a private transfer to suit your group size (up to 8 people). Avoid the long lines for taxis on arrival, and travel in the comfort of a Premium car or minivan.

items.n: The Málaga Market & Tapas Tour By Food Lover Tour
items.d:
This Market and Tapas Food Tour offers a deliciously engaging way to explore Málaga’s history and culture through its culinary traditions. This experience blends everything from traditional sweets and charming local shops to market bites, street food, and classic tapas — capturing the city’s diverse flavors and atmospheres in one unforgettable adventure.

Perfect for short stays, the tour is both comprehensive and dynamic, making it an ideal option for families and curious travelers alike. Why settle for a standard sightseeing tour when you can combine it with amazing food? Along the way, you’ll support small, family-run businesses and discover some of the most distinctive local products. By the end, you’ll have a handful of favorite places to return to during the rest of your time in Málaga.

items.n: Málaga Alcazaba and Gibralfaro Castle Admission Ticket
items.d:
Explore the rich history of Málaga with admission to the Alcazaba and Gibralfaro Castle. 
These iconic sites, dating back over a thousand years, showcase stunning Moorish architecture and fortified walls. 
Wander through the lush gardens of the Alcazaba before heading to Gibralfaro Castle, where you'll find panoramic views of the city, harbor, and Mediterranean Sea. 
This self-guided experience offers flexibility and the chance to delve into the cultural heritage of Andalusia at your own pace, making it a must-do for history lovers and sightseers alike.

items.n: Cordoba Day Trip : A Journey Through History from Malaga
items.d:
Relax on the bus journey while enjoying the Costa del Sol landscape and learning fascinating facts about the historic city of Cordoba. Upon arrival, cross the iconic Roman Bridge, featured in Game of Thrones, and enjoy 5 hours of free time to explore the city at your own pace.

Visit the Alcázar de los Reyes Cristianos, Plaza de la Corredera, Torre de la Calahorra, and the beautiful Andalusian patios in the San Basilio neighborhood. Let the city captivate you as you stroll through its historic streets, uncover its hidden gems, and savor local dishes like salmorejo, flamenquines, and bulltail.

You’ll also have time to relax on one of Cordoba’s terraces or soak up its unique atmosphere before returning to Malaga.

A perfect excursion to immerse yourself in Cordoba’s history and beauty in just one day.

items.n: Chamber of Secrets Skip the Line Ticket
items.d: Enjoy a night of live music, comedy, illusion, magic, and puppetry during this 3-hour family-friendly show in Torremolinos on the Costa del Sol. As you watch world class performers take the stage, sip on unlimited drinks. Hotel pickup\drop-off is not included.

items.n: Sailing at sunset along the cliffs of Maro-Compartida
items.d:
Sail on a sailboat enjoying a romantic sunset along the magnificent Tropical Coast of La Herradura-Maro-nerja.
Small groups.
Captain has great experience and professionalism.

A unique experience to share with family, couples or friends that you will never forget!

items.n: Oil Tasting in Ronda : Almazara El Toro
items.d:
THE El Toro Factory designed by Philippe Starck stands as the first author's mill in the world, fusing tradition, modernity and gastronomy in one place: the Sierra de Ronda. This space has been designed to highlight the culture and history of one of the emblematic products of Spanish gastronomy, with the collaboration of Philippe Starck, noted international designer.

LA Almazara El Toro allows you to witness firsthand the process of growing and transforming olive oil into an avant-garde building that has its own museum, tasting areas or auditorium for events in an incomparable place, the Sierra de Ronda. The building is a unique architectural gem, with a structure inspired by the personality of Andalusia: austere, rigorous, real, exaggerated, timeless, strong, spiritual and passionate.

items.n: Malaga Airport to Marbella Private Transfer
items.d:
Travel seamlessly from Malaga Airport to the stunning coastal gem of Marbella with a private transfer service that prioritizes your comfort and convenience. Your multilingual driver will be ready to greet you upon arrival, ensuring a smooth transition from the airport to your destination. Enjoy the scenic ride through picturesque Andalusian landscapes while your flight is monitored for timely pickups. Ideal for families and travelers seeking efficiency and ease, this service guarantees you arrive relaxed and ready to explore Marbella’s beautiful beaches and vibrant nightlife.

- Multilingual driver for a personalized experience
- Flight tracking service for guaranteed punctuality
- Direct transfer to your accommodation in Marbella
- Ideal for families and leisure travelers looking for comfort

items.n: Málaga Highlights Segway Tour
items.d:
Our visitors can enjoy the city in a fun way. They will discover its monuments and places without effort.

The highlights at the city center and views from Gibralfaro in only two hours.

After the tour you will be able to visit restaurants to try the local gastronomy.

items.n: Cordoba Full Day Trip with Mosque Entrance from Malaga
items.d: Join a full-day tour and discover the magical city of Córdoba. Stroll through its streets on our panoramic route and visit some of its most iconic landmarks. Discover Córdoba’s blend of cultures and explore the fascinating Jewish Quarter, a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Visit the Mosque with your local guide and marvel at its colorful mosaics and stained-glass windows. Enjoy free time for lunch and a walk through Córdoba’s historic city center. If you choose the on-your-own option, you will enjoy the city at your own pace.

items.n: Wine & Tapas tour by electric bike (e-bike) including Ronda pickup (half day)
items.d:
With us at EDIBLE BIKE TOURS you will visit local villages of El Jaral, El Gastor and Montecorto, all by electric bicycle. We cycle around back roads and stop regularly for photo stops and refreshments. The area is stunning with very few tourists, and the food and wine we experience are typically Spanish. You will be fully guided by us. Instruction for our e-bikes is provided as well as a practice ride before we depart, and we have a support vehicle following at all times (covered shoes are required).

Please note: The ability to ride a regular bicycle is required for this tour.

items.n: Dolphin Boat Trip in Benalmadena
items.d: We are much more than just a boat trip. We have a team of workers with more than 10 years of experience in the sector. A fully equipped and conditioned boat with the best features to offer the best service and comfort for our passengers, making them live one of the best experiences ever.

items.n: Nerja (Pueblo) + Frigiliana & El Acebuchal - Semi-Private
items.d:
"Its streets crowned the hill, as if rocked by the sea that painted that green background full of white polka dots in intense blue. The calm of its light accompanied us as we climbed its steep streets, leaving behind the old Ingenio once the hub of local commerce ..."

In this experience, he will take us through the streets of Nerja and its famous Balcony of Europe, as well as Frigiliana. This, known as the "Village of the Three Cultures", has a preferential place in the list of The Most Beautiful Towns of the Iberian Peninsula.

Today it offers us unique images, almost transporting us in space and time. Characteristics that make it an ideal destination not only for those who want to enjoy a pleasant visual walk through history and legends, but it is also an almost mandatory stop for photography lovers.

Likewise, we will direct our gaze to El Acebuchal, a town abandoned in times of the Civil War and today rebuilt.

items.n: Malaga Food Tour with 12+ Tastings: Tapas, Olive Oil, Ham & More
items.d:
Discover the culinary paradise of Málaga, nestled in the heart of Andalusia, Spain. Our vibrant city boasts a rich tapestry of flavors, steeped in history and set against the stunning backdrop of the Mediterranean. Indulge in hearty dishes like berenjenas con miel (fried eggplant drizzled with honey) and sip on sweet Málaga wine as you immerse yourself in the city's gastronomic delights. Whether you're exploring bustling markets like Atarazanas or savoring authentic
tapas in charming taverns, Málaga promises an unforgettable culinary journey. Join us on a food tour and let us guide you through the diverse flavors and traditions of our sun-soaked region firsthand. From traditional gazpacho to churros dipped in thick hot chocolate, Málaga’s cuisine is a celebration of Andalusian culture and Mediterranean charm.

items.n: Museum and Tour of La Rosaleda, Malaga CF Stadium
items.d: Welcome to an unforgettable journey through more than 100 years of football passion in Malaga! Immerse yourself in the magic of La Rosaleda Stadium and live a unique experience that will connect you to the history, spirit and emotions of this iconic venue.

items.n: Cordoba and its Mosque Tour from Málaga
items.d:
Discover the most emblematic monuments of Córdoba, as 

the Mosque-Cathedral. Do not miss the chance of visiting one of the most archetypal towns in Andalusia! Cordoba offers the possibility of experiencing culture, flamenco shows, bullfighting...

In this tour we will know the city of Cordoba, the capital city of the old Muslim Spain and the main city of the center of Andalusia. Going to the nord, the landscape becomes progressively wilder until we get to Sierra Morena range, famous because of its dense forests and their wild games. 

Cordoba is nowadays and how it still conserves the remains of its Iberian, Roman and Arab past. Cordoba is rich in traditions, it has a protruding architectural heritage and its cuisine has experienced a considerable resurgence because of the rebirth of a range of dishes of the traditional cooking of the region.

items.n: Half-Day Private Taxi Tour to Malaga Historic Center
items.d:
On this Tour of the Historic Center of Malaga, you will easily get to know the most outstanding monuments of greatest tourist and cultural interest. We will take a tour consisting of 7 stops through the most important areas of the city, starting from your hotel or pickup address. You have the option to extend the driver's waiting time during visits.
On the day of departure we will pick you up at the time indicated in your reservation. This route includes the pick-up, the tour route and the return transfer.
This experience is self-guided, the driver speaks Spanish.

items.n: 1 Hour Guided Adventure at Quads ATV in Mijas Malaga
items.d:
If you are in Malaga and adventurous, this is your best choice for a great experience.

On our guided excursions in Quads, we offer to know and visit the village of Mijas and the endless trails through the countryside that cross the mountains of Mijas and Marbella in a unique way that you cannot let escape.

Depending on the time of year we can cross riverbeds with water flow and make your experience even more authentic.

An important fact is that every day we will encounter a different type of fauna along the way, from a flock of sheep to horses, alpacas, donkeys, bulls, cows and birds of prey that fly over the area.

In all our tours we stop at places with panoramic views of the Costa del Sol to rest, have a refreshment and take photos with the participants.

Are you ready? Let the adventure begin!

items.n: Malaga Electric Bikes Guided Tour
items.d:
This 2h E-bike tour is the best to do during your stay in Malaga! Electric bikes are fantastic! If you have never used electric bike before, get ready to feel new amazing sensations! You only need to know how to ride a regular bicycle. 

Within two hours, we show you the best of Malaga in term of architecture, sceneries, and culture. items.n: Torremolinos with Picasso Clues Self Guided Treasure Hunt

On this amazing full day private excursion from Malaga to the Rock of Gibraltar, we will discover something of Gibraltar,s long and fascinating history. Gibraltar has been a British colony since 1703 and is now one of the last bastions of the British Empire.

With a private local Gibraltar guide, we`ll visit the Battle siege tunnels, with views over the top of the airport and beyond. One of the Pillars of Hercules where we can see North Africa, St. Michael's caves, where Neanderthals were discovered, the Moorish castle and the Ape,s den. We will head up to the top of the rock. Great for photos!
Gibraltar is of great strategic importance situated in a narrow strait which separates Europe from Africa and provides the only passage between the Atlantic and the Mediterranean. After the tour there will be free time for duty free shopping and lunch (not included)

items.n: Ronda Village Guided Tour from Costa del Sol

items.n: Private Day Tour in Gibraltar and Tangier, Morocco from Malaga

Thanks to our experience and knowledge of the region, we can offer you a deep insight into the history, culture and natural beauty of these places. Our passion for this unique area is reflected in the quality of the experience we offer.

items.n: Private Gibraltar Day Trip from Málaga or Marbella. Rock, Monkeys
items.d:
Private full-day Gibraltar tour from Málaga or Marbella. 
Just your group — door-to-door hotel pickup, local 
Gibraltar guide, all logistics handled.

YOUR DAY INCLUDES:

- Barbary macaques — 300 wild monkeys living freely on 
 the Rock. Europe's only wild monkey population.
- St. Michael's Cave — natural limestone cavern large 
 enough to host concerts. 1.5 million year old formations.
- Great Siege Tunnels — 18th-century artillery 
 emplacements carved by hand into the Rock face.
- Europa Point — southernmost Gibraltar, Morocco visible 
 14 km across the Strait on clear days.
- The runway crossing — planes taxi across the main road 
 into Gibraltar. Surprises everyone.
- Free time in town — duty-free shopping, British pubs, 
 Main Street.

⚠️ Valid passport required for every person in the group.

Costa Excursions — private tour operator based in Mijas 
since 2012. 4.9★ TripAdvisor, 175+ reviews. Peter and 
Thomas personally lead or oversee every tour.

items.n: Ronda Private Full Day Wine Tour
items.d:

But that's not all – we're off to the charming city of Ronda next! You'll have about two hours to roam around this picturesque place on your own. Imagine walking along the famous Puente Nuevo bridge, digging into local treats at cute cafes, and getting lost in the city's rich history. 

Get ready to sip on knowledge, soak in views, and savor the essence of both our vineyard and the delightful city of Ronda. It's a journey you won't want to miss – come explore with us!

items.n: Private tour from Malaga to the Alhambra Palace and Granada
items.d:
Taking this private tour from Malaga to Granada and the Alhambra Palace, we will visit one of the most beautiful architectural wonders of the world, it is home to two of Spain's best-known UNESCO World Heritage Sites.

We will explore with our private local Alhambra guide the gardens of the Generalife and the exquisite Moorish architecture of the Nasrid Palaces, framed by the stunning backdrop of the snow-covered Sierra Nevada Mountains. From these ancient Palaces and gardens, you will enjoy stunning views of the beautiful city of Granada and the Gypsy quarters of the Albaicín.

After this private Alhambra Palace tour, we will head up to the centre of Granada. You will have free time for lunch (not included), and then we head back to the coast.

items.n: Caminito del Rey Private Walking Tour
items.d:

This private tour goes beyond a simple trek; it's an immersive exploration of nature and history. Discover the secrets of El Caminito del Rey with your private guide, ensuring a unique and enriching experience, offering insights into the awe-inspiring beauty of this remarkable location that makes it truly exceptional

items.n: Ronda Historical Walking Tour with Bullring Entrance
items.d: Immerse yourself in Spanish tradition during this 2-hour walking tour of Ronda, the birthplace of modern bullfighting. See some of the city’s most famous landmarks, including Mondragon Palace and the stunning Nuestra Señora de la Paz church, and walk across the famous New Bridge. Then visit the bullring of the Royal Cavalry of Ronda for a look at a central tenet of Spanish culture. One of the oldest bullrings in Spain, the building is an important symbol for the city of Ronda.

items.n: Private tours from Malaga to Ronda and white village of Setenil

Then on to the picturesque town of Ronda which is famous for its river gorge known as El Tajo, which is viewed across the stunning 18th-century bridge called Puente Nuevo (new bridge).
Afterwards, we'll see all the highlights of this lovely town, which is one of the oldest in Spain, dating back to prehistoric times. We will do a walking tour with a private local Ronda guide for 2-hours of this historical town, starting from the town square, known as Plaza de España, and its beautiful church.
We will finally end up at Plaza de Toros Maestranza,and visit the Bullring, which is one of the oldest Bullrings in Spain. Afterwards, you'll have free time to enjoy lunch at a local restaurant (not included) before returning to the Costa Del Sol and Malaga

items.n: Malaga Food Walking Tour with Atarazanas Market Visit
items.d:
It is a cultural and gastronomic tour where participants discover family-run bars and taverns, including iconic places such as the Atarazanas Market and the city’s oldest tavern (dating back to 1840), accompanied by a licensed local guide.

 What the tour includes:
• Visits to five establishments, both traditional and modern.

• Sampling of typical specialties such as classic tapas, Malaga sweet wine, Iberian ham, chocolate with churros, and other local products.

Tour organizes cultural food tours in Malaga that combine history, traditional cuisine, and genuine interaction with local producers and restaurateurs, offering a complete immersion into Malaga’s culinary culture.

items.n: Tetouan Adventure : Guided Tour and Traditional Lunch from Malaga
items.d:
Embark on a day trip to Morocco from the Costa del Sol and discover the essence of Tetouan. We start with a bus ride from Malaga to Algeciras, where we’ll board the Fast-Ferry to Ceuta. Enjoy views of Ceuta’s walls on the way to the Moroccan border. After crossing into Morocco, we’ll head to Tetouan by bus.

Explore the city with our local guide, visiting key sights like Moulay El Mehdi Square, the Cathedral of Our Lady of Victory, the Jewish Mellah district, Hassan II Square, and the Royal Palace. Wander through the souk and the UNESCO-listed Medina.

Savor a traditional Moroccan lunch with a folkloric show and visit the famous Berber pharmacy to learn about the benefits of argan oil. After free time for shopping, we’ll return to Ceuta, board the ferry at 20:30, and head back to the pick-up point. Estimated arrival in Algeciras is at 21:30h.

items.n: From Malaga: Caminito del Rey tour with Private Transportation
items.d:
We are truly blessed with a natural wonder sculpted over millions of years: the mesmerizing Gaitanes Gorge.

The inception of this "trail" dates back to the 20th century What they ingeniously crafted is a pathway that's a mere 1 meter wide and extends for 3 kilometers, soaring an incredible 100 meters above the ground!

A few years later, during the inauguration of the Dam by the esteemed King Alfonso XIII, he traversed this extraordinary route and bestowed upon it the name it carries proudly to this day: "El Caminito del Rey."

Only 1 hour separate Malaga from El Chorro, the town where our adventure begins. The route itself is short and free of difficulties, spanning 3 kilometers of entirely flat terrain. However, the true allure lies in its extraordinary location, with sections suspended more than 100 meters above the river.
Prepare to meander along dizzying walkways, traverse the reservoir on towering bridges, and savor breathtaking views from precipitous lookout points.

items.n: Semi Private Tour to the Alhambra from Nerja
items.d:
La Alhambra is the most visited monument in Andalusia, reason why it should be on your list when visiting this lovely region of Spain. This magnificent monument is the greatest example of our Arabic past and the perfect witness of our interesting history since its creation. With our official guide you will learn about all this past and heritage, in a small group of maximal 8 participants. You will be able to take your time to enjoy this magnificent monument and our guide will be always available to you. After this incredible visit, we will take you to the Albayzin, the oldest and most beautiful neighborhood in Granada. It is a typical Andalusian neighbourghood with its white houses and narrow streets, and has been declared World Heritage by UNESCO in 1994. There, you will have free time to eat some tapas (so typical from Granada!) and will enjoy afterwards a guided visit in this georgeous neighbourgood.

NOTE: YOU MUST HAVE A GOOD WALKING CONDITION AS THE ALHAMBRA IS A LARGE MONUMENT.

items.n: Full Day Private Tangier Tour From Malaga
items.d:
Planning to go to Morocco for one day?
Long time Tangier welcomes travelers from many countries and is a gateway to Africa that brings together many civilizations and ancient societies. Famous for minarets, Moorish architecture and busty lifestyle it reveals the beauty of Mediterranean and Atlantic nature 
Explore spectacular panoramic views over Tangier's old and new city. You will be on the Mediterranean and Atlantic sides in one day, visiting predicates park, cap spartel, Hercules caves, seeing the meeting point of the Mediterranean Sea and the Atlantic Ocean and great lovely camels on the Achakar beach. Finally you will start with a walking part in Tangier Medina to see Kasbah and a museum, Berber markets, a food market, the Grand Rocco, American Legation, and more. During the tour, we stop for a Moroccan traditional lunch. A cup of refreshing mint tea or fresh orange juice will make the best of the day! Have a great tour!

items.n: Marbella : Private Catamaran with Drinks & Snacks
items.d:
Enjoy a truly unforgettable day aboard the beautiful catamaran Lagoon 380 DARIA! Capacity for 12 people + crew. Perfect for families, friends, hen-do party, stag party, birthdays or simply experience a relaxed cruise on the Mediterranean sea.

With its azure waters, golden sands, backdrop panoramic views of Marbella and tailored onboard services including music, drinks, and water activities, we offer the perfect setting for a sun-soaked cruise on the Costa del Sol.

Royal Catamaran provides a complete experience: drinks, delicious snacks, your playlist music connected to the boat, and the freedom to swim, sunbathe or toast under the Mediterranean sun.

The 2 and 3 hour cruises are specially curated for short and memorable activities on the sea. The activity blends sailing, engaging with the crew, while being served drinks and snacks, and possibility for a short swim break in the middle of the sea! The use of paddle boards, kayaks and snorkeling is weather dependent.

items.n: Evening Tapas Tour in Malaga
items.d:
Let us show you what’s behind the food and wine scene in Malaga with our complete Gourmet Tapas tour. Always in a small group no more than 10 people, perfect choice for cruise ship travelers, first time visitors in Malaga or simply those willing to discover what’s behind Malaga best eateries.

Indulge in some of Spain’s tapas treats at Malaga’s favorite foodie haunts on a walking tour of the old town. Stroll along the historic streets with a foodie guide, while tasting Spanish wines and learning about our best culinary treasures. Get off the beaten path and eat like a local while having fun and learning about Malaga’s tapas traditions! The 3-hour tapas tour will take you to popular spots and introduce you to some hidden treats in Malaga! 

In all different places you will taste typical Spanish tapas, accompanied by local wines, a complete lunch or dinner, including a wine tasting. Explore the city center while you walk from place to place.

items.n: Private tours from Malaga to Tangiers in Morocco all inclusive
items.d:
Discover the magic of Morocco on a private day trip to Tangier from Malaga and the Costa Del Sol. Morocco lies just across the Mediterranean Sea from southern Spain, but this North African country feels like a world away!
We journey across the Straits of Gibraltar on a high-speed ferry and arrive at the port of Tangier where you will be met by our private local Morocco guide.
Taking an interesting drive through the richest area of Tangier’s zone of villas and palaces passing via the king's palace and celebrities' homes (Barbara Hutton and Malcolm Forbes).
Visit Cape Spartel which is the northeast western point of Africa, it is the exact point where the Mediterranean and the Atlantic Ocean meet. Then visit the Caves of Hercules (dating from the Neolithic era). A stop to take pictures of the camels and experience a ride. 
We then head for the Kasbah and the Medina, the oldest and the most exotic part of this mythical city .

items.n: Marbella Private Sailboat: Paddle Board and Pool in the Sea (10 pax)

All dishes will be fully explained by your local guides, experts in gastronomic tourism. Enjoy good company and conversation while feeding your senses with this experience.

Combine gastronomy with the best flamenco art center in the city. After enjoying Malaga tapas and wines, get excited with an authentic flamenco show with a welcome drink.

items.n: Private tours from Malaga to Cordoba with the Great Mezquita
items.d:
On this private day trip from Malaga to Cordoba and the Arabic Mosque, you will experience the charm and delights of Cordoba. This ancient city was long ago the capital of Spain during Moorish times and the largest city in Europe.

With our private local Cordoba guide, we will visit the impressive Arabic Mosque, giving you an insight into Cordoba's past and history. The Mosque at the time was the largest in the world and after the conquest by the Christians, a Cathedral was built right in the middle of the Mosque! Afterwards, we will visit the ancient, narrow, winding streets of the Jewish Quarter, the Synagogue and the Roman bridge. (approx. 2 hours)

You will have plenty of free time to explore Cordoba even further and enjoy lunch (not included)

items.n: Malaga Monuments Private Walking Tour
items.d: The best cultural tour in town, explaining the main monuments and the stories behind them in a deep and professional way, helped by certain revealing images that will be shown along the visit. If you only have one day in Malaga, this is definitely your tour!

items.n: Private trip to Nerja with hotel or shore pickup in Malaga
items.d:
Embark on a captivating private day trip to Nerja, a beautiful coastal village in Malaga, and immerse yourself in the essence of Andalucía. Your adventure includes:
- Journey along the Eastern Coastal road, taking in the stunning views of the Mediterranean Sea and the picturesque coastline.

- Explore the renowned Nerja Cave, a prehistoric wonder adorned with impressive auditoriums and galleries.

- Discover Nerja town, a charming Andalusian gem. Visit the iconic Balcony of Europe, offering breathtaking sea views, and wander through the typical Andalusian streets.

items.n: Go local for a day!
items.d:
This adventure has 2 of the most important ingredients to make your walk around Malaga an UNFORGETTABLE visit: the experience of local 'malagueñas'; and also officially qualified tour guides.

The idea is not to talk about a huge amount of historical facts, nor to treat you as just another tourist. The purpose is to experience and feel the city as a REAL LOCAL, a real "malagueño".

The duration of this activity is 2,5h and it starts at one of the most iconic squares of the city: Plaza de la Merced.

Then, the walk will get started around the historical area in order to discover the most well-known places (as well as surprising, unknown ones) of the centre, while talking about history, curiosities, traditions... 
Where do locals go, what are our customs, where do we go and what do we eat?

To end the tour, we'll visit the Central Market where we'll try local products and then we'll toast with some nice sweet wine to say goodbye.

DO YOU FANCY ENJOYING A TOUR WITH A DIFFERENCE? Let's go!

items.n: Guided Tour to the only coffee farm in Europe
items.d:
Unique experience, there is no other coffee plantation further north in the world, we also grow more than 30 varieties of exotic fruit trees including red banana, dragon fruit and chocolate flavoured black sapote.

The environment is wonderful with a farmhouse more than 300 years old, paved access and very green with clean air.

items.n: Private Tour: Tangier From Malaga. Breakfast and Lunch Included
items.d: On this tour, Our main focus is to immerse ourselves in Tangier as soon as we arrive. The entire tour will be done on foot, concentrating on visiting museums, palaces, and markets. We'll dive deep into the Medina and the Kasbah, experiencing them in their purest form, giving us ample time to explore the rich culture and the historic old town of Tangier. If you wish, we can also indulge in the local gastronomy. Plus, we're flexible and can add anything you'd like or adapt the tour to your needs. The idea is to have a relaxed schedule, enjoy our time together, and provide you with a wonderful introduction to Morocco.

items.n: The Best of Málaga Private Walking Tour – Complete Experience
items.d: Our tour offers a truly authentic and immersive experience of Málaga, led by a passionate local guide who brings the city’s history, culture and hidden stories to life. We go beyond the typical tourist route, combining iconic landmarks with local traditions, gastronomy stops and charming corners that most visitors miss. With small groups only, we guarantee a personalised, relaxed and engaging experience, allowing you to connect deeply with the city, ask questions freely and enjoy Málaga at a comfortable pace. From historic monuments to local flavours like churros with chocolate, every moment is carefully designed to make your visit memorable, cultural and genuinely special.

items.n: Alhambra Private Tour from Malaga: with transport and skip-the-line-tickets
items.d:
Submerge yourself in the history of the last Moorish kingdom in Western Europe. The Alhambra has some of the secrets of the unique Spanish-Muslim culture that lasted for over 700 years hidden away inside. You will not be able to explore these charms anywhere else in the world.

A stunningly well-preserved complex of Medieval palaces where it is still possible to feel the presence of its previous oweners. The paradise-like gardens are only a few of the gems that await you in the unique setting.

Find out more about the plots and intirgues that provoked the failure of the Moorish Kingdom of Granada when faced with a Christian assault.

Enjoy your private vehicle with your personal driver that will pick you up from your hotel and drive you to the Alhambra where you will meet your guide. After your private visit in Alhambra the driver will take you back to your place.

items.n: Morocco: All-Inclusive Semi-Private Tangier Tour (Up to 7 Pax)
items.d:
Semi-private, max 7 guests — small, intimate, personal.

Your guide, from Málaga to Málaga. They board the ferry with you, walk you through Moroccan customs, stay by your side all day, and return with you. One guide, one group, the entire day — no confusion, no waiting, no lost time.

The iconic stops, done right: camel ride on the Atlantic & Cape Spartel.

The real Tangier most tourists miss: Kasbah, Medina, markets, palaces, museums, and historic synagogues — the old town other tours skip.

Authentic Moroccan lunch in a traditional Medina restaurant — tagine, couscous, mint tea. No tourist traps.

All-inclusive: ferry, guide, transport, camel ride, Cape Spartel, and lunch. You bring your passport; we handle the rest.

100% culture. 0% wasted time.

items.d:
Visit one of the most beautiful cities of Andalusia, Malaga, a city that hosted a wide variety of cultures during its whole history. From phoenicias, romans and visigoths, to the actual Spain. 

Your guide will meet you once you arrive to Malaga for 4 hours. 

Among other monuments and places you can choose to see the Roman-era sites, such as the roman theater. You will start your tour in Malaga going up to the Castle of Gibralfaro, which dates from the 10th Century, from where you will be able to enjoy astonishing views of the city of Malaga. Your private official tour guide will show you the historic center of Malaga, you will see the fantastic cathedral, the Picasso museum and many more!

Your private vehicle will be at your whole disposition during the 10h tour. You will enjoy a private guided tour, with a official tour guide in Malaga for 4 hours. When the tour is finished, you will have time to eat something and relax in Malaga, before your private driver takes you back to Seville.

Discover the Spanish Quarter and Grand Mosque, stroll the medina, sip mint tea in the kasbah, and see the Hercules Caves, all while hearing facts and history from your driver and guide you could miss alone.

Enjoy the exclusivity and personalized attention that a private walking tour provides. Your guide will tailor the experience to your interests, ensuring an immersive and enjoyable exploration of Ronda.

items.n: Private Full-Day Tour of Ronda from Marbella with Hotel pick up
items.d:
Your tour of Ronda begins with a convenient pickup in Marbella from you private guide and chauffeur. Settle in to your exclusive car and enjoy a scenic 1-hour ride to Ronda, a city first founded by the Romans as a fortified post. 

Your guide will meet you once you arrive to Ronda.  

In Ronda, let your guide be your teacher as they lead you to the most enchanting sites in the city. Among many of the monuments, you can choose to see are the Bridges of Ronda, three bridges spanning the Tajo canyon, named Puente Romano, Puente Viejo and Puente Nuevo. You may also explore sites such as the former Town Hall, Corrida Goyesca, one of the oldest bullfighting rings in Spain, and the Arab Baths, considered to be one of the best preserved in Europe. 

In Ronda enjoy a 3h visit, the rest of the time is free time. 

Your private luxury vehicle with chauffeur will be at your disposal throughout the tour, so you can enjoy the monuments to the fullest and get the best out of your experience in the city.

items.n: Private tour in Gibraltar & Mijas from Malaga
items.d:
From the British influence in Gibraltar to the authentic charm of Mijas pueblo, this journey promises a rich and diverse experience for the entire family. Here's what makes our tour a unique and enriching experience:
- Gibraltar's Natural Wonders: The Nature Reserve, including St. Michael's Cave, Pillars of Hercules, the Great Siege Tunnels & the Moorish castle. Interact with the playful monkeys, creating joyful memories for the whole family. 
- Educational Experience: Learn about its unique blend of British influence.
- Family-Focused Exploration: Engage with Gibraltar's attractions and wildlife in a way that captivates the entire family.
- Andalusian Charm in Mijas pueblo: well-preserved old town with whitewashed houses, blue pots and vibrant flowers. Witness the unique blend of tradition & tranquility that characterizes this picturesque town.
- Contrasting Landscapes: Be captivated by the stark contrast between the natural wonders of Gibraltar and the serene beauty of Mijas pueblo.

items.n: Private Day Trip To Gibraltar from Marbella or Marbella
items.d:
Day trip visit to Gibraltar from Malaga or Marbella with this private, guided tour. After being picked up by your private driver at your hotel or apartment, we will drive along the coast  to Gibraltar (1:50 h), upon arrival to Gibraltar, you will meet your private guide at the border, and venture into the center of the city together.

Discover Gibraltar, the british colony located just closet o the Costa del Sol. Enjoy this personalized and private tour from Malaga or Marbella with a local guide and private car or mini van. Get to know this beautiful city with your private tour guide.

Visit the southernmost point of the rock, see wild monkeys, and view St. Michael’s Cave. Cross off Gibraltar’s most essential sights in a short space of time Tour with a guide who can provide historical context See Europa Point and Apes’ Den, with optional visit to World War II Tunnels. Hassle-free transport from central Gibraltar.

items.n: Tangier and Asilah Private Tour with from Malaga or Marbella
items.d:
The tour will start from Málaga, Marbella or Gibraltar Border (Spanish side). Also, we can start the tour directly in Tarifa port in case you have your own vehicle.

You will take the ferry from Tarifa up to Tangier. Once in Tangier you will meet your private guide and driver.

We’ll take a ride through different neighbourhoods and surrounding areas, including several stops at amazing viewpoints, a short break at Cape Spartel where the Atlantic Ocean meets the Mediterranean Sea, a visit to the mythical Caves of Hercules. 

You will also have the opportunity to enjoy a 15-minute camel ride!

After that, you will have the chance to visit the Kasbah (fortress) and have a view of the Medina (old town).

We will then head towards Asilah to get to know this unique city. Walk around the city and enjoy its narrow and beautiful old town feeling.

Finally you will take you ferry back to Tarifa where your driver will take you back toy our accommodation.

items.n: Full Day Private Tour in Alhambra from Malaga
items.d:
Once inside this Private Tour Alhambra from Malaga you will visit the Nasrid Palaces . The first of them is the Comares Palace, it is the monarch’s quarters. A beautiful place with a series of inscriptions and ornaments that take the breath away from anyone who sees it for the first time. It is located around the Patio de los Arrayanes.

The second building is the Palace of the Lions. It is actually the third most important palace of the whole complex and the site of the famous Patio de los Leones.

Once the military world of the Nasrid dynasty has been abandoned, it is time to visit the famous “Garden of the Architect”. Better known as the Generalife, a rural villa, designed for the relaxation and relaxation of the Muslim kings.

You will move forward in time to the Renaissance period with the Palace of Charles V. 

Enjoy this private tour with professionals

items.d: Discover the charm and glamour of southern Spain on this private ride from Málaga to Marbella and Puerto Banús. Then head to Puerto Banús, famed for its luxury yachts, designer shops, and upscale cafés. Enjoy free time to shop, relax by the marina, or soak in the high-end coastal vibe. Your English-speaking driver ensures a smooth, comfortable experience with hotel pickup and dropoff. items.n: Private trail in El Torcal from Marbella or Malaga
items.d:
Connect with the pristine beauty of this UNESCO World Natural Site. 
Venture into the magical El Torcal Nature Reserve, known for its dramatic limestone formations and diverse flora and fauna that makes El Torcal a must-visit destination.

Follow a professional guide who will lead you through the reserve, providing insights into the geological features, local wildlife and the beautiful vegetation that thrives in El Torcal.

Many of limestone formations take on unique shapes, offering a surreal and otherworldly landscape for you to explore.

Capture the beauty of the landscape with your camera and enjoy a memorable hiking experience. The unique geological features and natural beauty of El Torcal provide excellent photography opportunities.

Enjoy the convenience of roundtrip transportation from your hotel in Marbella, Malaga, or other Costa del Sol towns. Relax and focus on the natural wonders awaiting you in El Torcal.

items.n: Tour the Sanctuary and Walk with the Donkeys and Share their Love
items.d:
Walk with the donkeys and share their love! Donkey Dreamland, both a Donkey Rescue Centre and a Donkey Sanctuary, is set in acres of beautiful countryside surrounded by rolling hills of meadow grasses and old olive trees. The only sounds are those of the birds in their natural habitat and the donkeys braying. 

You will find it hard to believe that you are just five minutes drive from the beach and a choice of fantastic bars and restaurants, but that is the case, so you have somewhere to go for an evening meal after your Donkey Dreamland experience.

Your expert local guide then leads you through the Alcazaba, Málaga’s renowned Moorish fortress. Wander its intricate arches, tranquil courtyards, and lush gardens while hearing captivating stories of its past and exploring remarkable architectural details. 

Finish with a relaxing stroll through Málaga’s harbor district, lined with charming cafés and boutiques that capture the city’s modern energy. Ronda offer us the chance to experience culture, nature and it celtic origins, an extraordinary mix that will stun you with its beauty.

items.n: Mijas Marbella and Puerto Banus Tour from Malaga Costa del Sol
items.d:
Mijas is one of the most beautiful white villages on the whole Costa del Sol with a spectacular view over the coast and a tour within the same very welcoming village. Mijas Pueblo offers visitors several interesting historical buildings to visit, such as the tiny Bullring of irregular shape; two hermitages from the 17th century, the remains of the ancient Arab wall in which are beautiful gardens and the interesting Sanctuary of the Virgin of Peña, patron saint of the town. 

Marbella is one of the most important tourist cities on the Costa del Sol and in all of Spain. Panoramic tour of the historic center where you can admire: the Plaza de los Naranjos, the Old Wall, the Parish Church and the Chapel of San Juan de Dios.

Puerto Banús is a luxury marina, located between Marbella and San Pedro Alcántara; it is one of the largest entertainment centers on the Costa del Sol.

items.n: Marbella: Shared Sailing Trip with Dolphin Watching
items.d:
Watching dolphins swim free alongside the sailboat is a moment few
experiences on land can match — an encounter many of our passengers
describe as magical and unforgettable, one that fills you with awe and
respect for these creatures.

From the sea, the view of Marbella is unlike any other: the Golden Mile,
the La Concha mountains, and on the clearest days, even the northern
coast of Africa can be made out on the horizon, surrounded by that
silvery blue so characteristic of summer in this area.

All of this is experienced in a small group of no more than 9 people,
which makes every trip feel personal and relaxed — never like a mass
tour.

When the sea allows, we stop for a swim in crystal-clear waters, and
back on board, we toast with a glass of cava as the sailboat continues
on its course.

It's an afternoon that combines nature, scenery, and a moment of calm
out at sea.

items.d:

Frigiliana: Wander through this picturesque whitewashed village, known for its narrow cobblestone streets, vibrant flowers, and breathtaking views of the mountains and sea.
Nerja Caves: Discover the awe-inspiring underground world of the Nerja Caves, featuring massive stalactites, stalagmites, and one of the world’s largest natural columns. A true marvel of nature!
Balcony of Europe: End your adventure at this iconic cliffside viewpoint in Nerja, offering panoramic vistas of the sparkling Mediterranean Sea and dramatic coastline.
Experience the perfect blend of history, nature, and stunning landscapes in one incredible day!

items.d:

Start in the late afternoon or early evening to enjoy the sunset over the Mediterranean. Drive the car yourself in a fun and eco-friendly Citroën Ami, following an easy and well-planned route at a relaxed pace.

The route includes Málaga’s main landmarks, scenic viewpoints, and lively areas. One highlight is a stop at Gibralfaro Castle, offering panoramic views of the illuminated city and coastline — perfect for photos.

As night falls, drive through the historic center, passing charming squares and vibrant streets, while learning interesting facts about Málaga.

This two-seater experience combines sustainability, culture, and great views for a unique way to discover Málaga.

It will fill you with much happiness.
At the end of the class you can take a nice souvenir foto.
The place of the class is in the center of Málaga. A very beautiful and emblematic place "Galerías Goya". It is surrounded by shops and restaurants. 
This class is very familiar and is filled with much charm. At the end all participants receive a sweet surprise.

items.d:

Enjoy this adventure tour that combines iron stair climbing, zip lining and crossing bridges at the same time. El Chorro Via Ferrata is a long tour that merges all these activities with monkey and Tibetan bridges. With no doubt, the best Vía Ferrata in Andalusia.

This tour is not just a walk, it is an experience for the senses: you will feel the breeze on top of the cliffs, the vibration of the suspension bridges under your feet and the majesty of a place that has captivated travelers from all over the world. Every step connects you to the force of nature and the history of this gorge that for decades was considered inaccessible. At the end, you will return with the satisfaction of having conquered a unique place and a sense of adventure that you will never forget.

The experience culminates with a tasting of three wines accompanied by a tapa of cured cheese, perfect for all audiences. Real Alcázar de Sevilla
Immerse yourself in the magic of this palace complex declared a World Heritage Site. Its courtyards, halls and spectacular gardens will transport you to the time of kings and caliphs, with architecture that mixes the Arab, Mudéjar and Renaissance.

Santa Cruz District
Stroll through the old Jewish Quarter, a maze of narrow streets and orange groves that keep centuries of history. A place full of charm, legends and perfect corners to be carried away by the most authentic Sevillian atmosphere.

Cathedral and Giralda
Discover the Cathedral of Seville, one of the largest in the world, and admire its imposing tower, the Giralda, from which you can enjoy unique views of the city. Inside you will find true jewels of art and the place where Christopher Columbus rests.

Next stop. You will explore its Moorish Old Town through

items.d:
Looking for a day off the beaten path? Come explore La Alpujarra, one of Andalusia’s most charming and authentic mountain regions — all in one relaxing day from Nerja.

Your private driver will pick you up at your accommodation and take you up into the hills. First stop: Pampaneira, a picture-perfect village with flower-filled streets, cozy artisan shops, and plenty of local goodies to taste and take home.

Next, we’ll visit Bubión, where you’ll step inside a traditional Alpujarran house and get a feel for what mountain life is (and was) really like.

We’ll end the trip in Capileira, the highest village in the area, with jaw-dropping views and a great spot to grab lunch before heading back to Nerja.

It’s a chill, scenic, and deeply local experience — perfect for travelers who want to slow down and soak up real Andalusian life.

Upon arrival in Seville, enjoy a 2-hour private walking tour with a knowledgeable local guide, covering the city’s most iconic landmarks—including the exteriors of the Seville Cathedral, the Giralda Tower, the Royal Alcázar, and the picturesque Santa Cruz district. Please note that this tour includes exterior visits only; if you'd like to visit the interior of any monument, you must let us know in advance so we can organize tickets and timing accordingly.

After the guided tour, you’ll have up to 3 hours of free time to explore Seville at your own pace. Whether you want to relax by the river, discover hidden corners of the old town, or enjoy lunch at one of the guide’s recommended local bars, the afternoon is yours to enjoy.

items.n: 7-Day Morocco Tour from Tangier
items.d:
The Four Imperial Cities of Morocco are Fez, Marrakech, Meknes and Rabat. The Middle Atlas consists of cities of Fez, Meknes and Volubilis, The High Atlas is the city of Marrakech. The Atlantic Cities consist of Casablanca and Rabat.On this imperial cities tour we introduce to you an enriching insight into the rich history of imperial Morocco through its majestic palaces, UNESCO World Heritage Sites and magnificent monuments, labyrinthine medinas and lively and exciting souks. Included guided tours will reveal the highlights of the 4 imperial cities. Stay in beautiful authentic riads close to the main attractions in the heart of each imperial city. 

***

Explore Antequera town where Christian and Moorish influences converge, creating a fascinating blend of cultures, tales and history.

Discover the remnants of the Roman baths, a testament to Antequera's historical importance as a crossroads for different civilizations.

Immerse yourself in the cultural and religious significance of Antequera in the Modern Age. The largest numbers of churches in Spain are in Antequera. 

Visit the Alcazaba, an ancient Moorish fortress that stands as a symbol of Antequera's defensive history in the Middle Ages.

Marvel at the unique and otherworldly limestone landscapes of this significant karst area in Europe: El Torcal.

Enjoy the convenience of roundtrip transportation from your hotel.

Malaga is one of the largest cities in Andalusia, it has beautiful beaches and coastal areas that make it the perfect place to spend your holidays.

With our private local Seville guide, we will visit the Moorish site of Real Alcazar, the most ancient royal palace still in use in Europe.
Founded by the Muslim People one thousand years ago. Next to Alcazar and the Cathedral we have Santa Cruz, the old Jewish Quarter.
Here we shall walk through the narrow and serpentine streets with a special secret as well as a peaceful atmosphere.

Later we'll go to visit the Cathedral of Seville, the third largest one in the Christian world, and one of the richest.
Inside, you will find the real tomb of Christopher Columbus!

We will also see (and climb if you want) the Giralda Tower, old minaret and symbol of Seville.

You will have plenty of free time to explore Seville even further and enjoy lunch (not included)

items.d: We will visit places at the city center but not so much known for tourists, explained in a deep and professional way, helped by certain revealing images that will be shown along the visit. If you already know Malaga, this tour will unveil you an unknown city, and if you are a newcomer, you will enjoy anyway all these fascinating stories.

items.n: Murder City Game with Live Game Supervisor in Málaga
items.d:

With photos and a city map, you go into the city, looking for the right locations. At each location you take a group selfie and receive a new clue. Step by step you are getting closer to the truth.
Can you solve the murder within 3 hours? In the meantime, you will discover surprising places you would normally pass by. This is no ordinary city walk, but an interactive experience that you experience together.

items.n: Malaga Private Walking Tour with a Professional Guide
items.d:

An activity where we can learn the art of the “espeto”, rooted in the coast of Malaga for centuries. We will visit the fishermen´s quarter par excellence of Malaga, as well as a craft workshop of the typical boats called “jábegas”. 
An amazing activity for couples and family in a private tour.
Tradition, gastronomy and sea from Malaga beach

items.n: Secrets of Málaga: Self-Guided Scavenger Hunt & Walking Tour

This GPS-based exploration game lets you experience Málaga while exploring famous spots such as Málaga Cathedral, the Teatro Romano, the Arco del Pasaje de Chinitas, the Pirámide de Cristal, the Centro Cultural Fundación Unicaja and the Fuente de Génova. This one in particular is set in the 1960s on Hawaii's famous Waikiki Beach, where surf instructors began using longer, more stable boards to photograph their group. Thus, and using canoe paddles, they could move to also check the technique of their pupils and to see in advance the possible risks and the waves that were to come.

items.n: Spanish Cooking Class with local Grandma
items.d:
Discover the Flavours of Málaga with a Real Andalusian Abuela

Join us for a one-of-a-kind cooking class where tradition, flavour, and storytelling come together. In this authentic culinary experience, you’ll cook side by side with a beloved local abuela — a grandmother from Málaga — who has spent over 80 years mastering family recipes passed down through generations.

This is not your typical cooking class. It’s an immersion into the heart of Andalusian culture and cuisine, guided by women who carry the true soul of Málaga in their hands. Learn to prepare at least 3 traditional dishes using local ingredients, just like their mothers and grandmothers taught them.

Along the way, you’ll hear stories from the pueblo, taste delicious regional tapas, and enjoy a glass of local wine — all in a warm, hands-on atmosphere led by an abuela and a passionate food expert.

items.n: e-MTB (Self-Guided)Montejaque & Hundidero Dam - 38km Intermediate
items.d:
This route makes a circuit to the west of Ronda, passing through rural countryside and through two small, sleepy white villages. It is an off-road version of our Leisure e-bike ride: Cueva del Gato & Montejaque, which means less road and more tracks and paths. 

From Ronda we head down into the valley directly below the town, for great views up to the main Puente Nuevo bridge. We climb out of the valley and then drop down again to the Guadiaro river, where we make a short stop at the Cueva del Gato, “Cat Cave”. This is a local beauty spot, with a small waterfall and beautiful pool of crystal clear (but very cold!) water. We climb steadily up into the mountains, through the village of Benaojan and on to Montejaque, where we usually make a quick coffee stop on the village square We continue down through farmland into the valley of La Indiana before using trails which head up through pine-forested hills to climb back to Ronda.

items.n: Guided visit to the Cathedral of Malaga and its surroundings
items.d:
In our hour and a half visit we will detail the history and artistic aspects of La Manquita, the undisputed symbol of the city. The main milestones of the Catholic conquest will be the basis of our tour, which we will extrapolate to the artistic field and will explain the reason for being of the Cathedral of Malaga.

In addition, we will know the surroundings of the cathedral, such as the Sagrario church, where its direct antecedents are found; the Santo Tomás Hospital, one of the oldest hospitals in the capital, and which makes Calle Santa María one of the most beautiful in the historic center of Malaga; and the Plaza del Obispo, one of the most emblematic squares in the city where we will also mention both the Episcopal Palace and the main facade of the Cathedral of the Incarnation.

items.n: White Peoples of Axarky & Buddhist / Semi-Private Stupa
items.d:
Welcome to La Axarquia, a land as peculiar as it is different. A whole orchard in which different cultures settled in the heat of its subtropical climate and a fertile land that rises imposingly in front of the sea, offering us panoramic views that will surely remain engraved in our retinas.

Our first stop will be in El Borge, a small white Andalusian town and once a land of bandits. After touring its alleys, we set off again making a brief stop to visit the old Muslim fountain of Cútar.

From here we arrive at Comares, a white town with a unique location, which allows us to enjoy one of the most impressive views of the province.

After free time to eat and before returning to the starting point, a surprise: we will discover one of the most important Buddhist stupas outside the Asian continent as well as an old watchtower that has surveyed the valley since Al Andalus times.

items.n: Ronda Self-Guided City Walking Tour & Scavenger Hunt
items.d:

This app-led scavenger hunt takes you through Ronda on foot, using phone-based riddles to guide you from one landmark to the next. No guide, no fixed start time.

• Follow riddles to the Puente Nuevo, the Plaza Duquesa de Parcent, and the Jardines de Cuenca — engineering wonder, Moorish heritage, and cliff-edge gardens
• Move through Ronda at your own pace with no fixed schedule

Available in 24 languages including English, French, German, Spanish, Italian — see the full list when booking and choose yours when you start the game in the app.

Hemingway fell for Ronda. This walk explains why.

items.d:

It is a great ride for families, kids and less regular cyclists. You will ride through rural farmland and past woodland, hillside vineyards and acres of olive groves.

In Setenil you will see “cavehouse” dwellings built into the rock, which are now houses, shops and cafes. You can enjoy a refreshment stop in one of these cafes before we meet you with the minibus to drive back up the hill to Ronda.

items.n: Hiking - Montejaque to Ronda - 11km Moderate
items.d:
This walk takes us from the small white village of Montejaque, nestled into a niche amongst rocky mountain peaks at the edge of the Sierra de Grazalema, to Ronda. We follow the original pathways that took villagers, drovers and their wares from the mountain village into the town in the days before cars, roads and railways.

After a short tour of the village we exit via a stone “zigzag path”. This is a short, steep climb that takes us up into the mountains, past a small chapel and a hidden plateau. We continue through the hills, past huge agave cactus plants, olive groves and farms, with stunning views across the countryside. We climb to a viewpoint where Ronda’s position on top of a sheer rock wall lays before us, then drop down into the fertile valley below the town. We walk directly below the walls of the gorge and enjoy iconic views of the Puente Nuevo bridge, before climbing to our finish point in one of Ronda’s oldest districts, the Barrio San Francisco.

items.n: Feria de Málaga Special: Authentic Sevillanas Dance Workshop

It has a standard choreography for everyone. This dance is very very fast and quite difficult. But in this activity you can learn it in just 45 minutes very easily. The steps are very adapted for any level. The music of this dance is wonderful. It will fill you with a lot of happiness. And most importantly, you can dance safely at any party. And so you can enjoy flamenco and Spanish dance to the fullest. It is also a class that will fill you with a lot of energy. You will do a very good exercise for your body. It will help you get to know Spanish culture and music in a very authentic way. These classes will be a nice memory of your stay in Malaga. Especially advisable to do this class in August when there is the fair in Malaga. After this class you can go directly to practice, dancing in the streets of the city.

items.n: Skip-The-Line Access to MEET and Colección del Museo Ruso-Malaga
items.d:
La antigua Tabacalera incorpora una nueva etapa en su trayectoria cultural. Al programa de la Colección del Museo Ruso se suma el Espacio Expositivo Tabacalera (MEET), una línea propia de exposiciones con obras y artistas de procedencia nacional e internacional que convivirá con la oferta ya consolidada del centro.
Con esta decisión, el edificio refuerza su papel como uno de los grandes contenedores culturales de la ciudad y abre la puerta a proyectos expositivos diversos, sin renunciar al vínculo con el arte y la cultura rusos.

items.n: Cordoba Private Tour from Malaga and Costa del Sol
items.d: Founded by the Romans in the middle of the 2nd century BC, it became the capital of Later Hispania in the time of the Roman Republic, in addition to the province Betica, being one of the most prosperous and cultured cities of the Roman Empire. After the Muslim invasion of Hispania in the century. VIII, the city rose as the capital of the Emirate of Córdoba, while in the 10th century during the Caliphate of Córdoba it became one of the main cities in the world both in population and for its medical, mathematical, artistic, philosophical, literary, scientific, etc. It had an important Christian and Jewish community that dwindled over time due to repression by the Muslim authorities.6 7 8 With the Castilian reconquest of 1236 by Ferdinand III, Córdoba returned to medieval Christian faith and customs.

items.n: Malaga Essentials: An Audio Tour of its Heritage and Identity

As you explore the historic center, you’ll hear the fascinating stories behind Málaga’s most iconic landmarks. You’ll also find out how this coastal city became the vibrant cultural destination it is today. Your journey begins at the Monument to the Marquee of Larios on Plaza de la Marina. You’ll weave through medieval alleys to the stunning Atarazanas Central Market, housed in what was once an Islamic shipyard from the 1500s. Along the way, you’ll discover Casa del Guardia, one of Málaga’s oldest wineries, where you can sample the sweet Moscatel wines that have made the region famous. The tour ends near Málaga’s City Hall, designed by renowned local architect Fernando Guerrero Strachan.

items.n: Watchtowers Hiking Route
items.d:
The Cerro Gordo Tower was built in the 16th century on top of an old watchtower from the times of the Kingdom of Granada to protect the workers and fishermen in the area. It visually connects to the west with the Caleta or Cantarriján tower, and to the east with the Torre de la Herradura.
Formerly it was a favorable place for pirates, who took control of this area to enter the territory and cause terror in the native population, a fact that had a decisive influence on the low number of residents who lived in the towns nearby.

items.d: The passion, romance, mystique, beauty and history of Spain are nowhere more evident than in ancient Andalusia, the vast southern region whose name has become a byword for Spanish culture. Marvel at the dramatic New and Old Bridges spanning the spectacular Tajo Gorge, and step inside Spain’s historic Ronda Bullring, the birthplace of modern bullfighting. Stroll along charming streets like Carrera Espinel, soak in panoramic views, and discover the layers of Roman, Moorish, and Spanish history that make Ronda a truly unforgettable destination.

The driver will pick you up from your hotel in Malaga and our official private guide will be waiting for you in Ronda for a 4 hours tour of Ronda and Setenil. 

Setenil de las Bodegas is a Spanish municipality in the province of Cádiz, Andalusia. Its urban fabric is declared a Historic Site, whose centre is embedded in the gorge formed by the Trejo River as it passes through the town.

Situated in the middle of the Tajo hill, Ronda was built in the 1st century BC by the Roman emperor Julius Caesar, then conquered by the Moors in the 8th century AD.

Today, it is the third most visited city in Andalusia. You will enjoy getting to know this magnificent city together with a private official guide, who will be at your disposal for 4 hours in Ronda.

The next day, embark on a guided minivan tour to Grazalema and Zahara de la Sierra, focusing on the endangered pinsapo fir tree. Day four features an exhilarating e-bike ride along the Via Verde de la Sierra, one of Spain's premier cycling trails. items.n: Priv. tour in Antequera w/ hotel or shore pickup at Costa del Sol
items.d:
Embark on a private trip to Antequera, a magnificent and historically rich town steeped in religious monuments and captivating tales. 

Antequera served as a crucial border territory between Christians and Moors during the Middle Ages, giving rise to numerous stories & legends. Notably, Washington Irving, the renowned American author, also included Antequera in his stories. 

Our exploration will lead us to the citadel; remnants of Roman baths - providing a glimpse into the city's ancient past and the influence of Roman civilization on Antequera-; the remains of the city wall - reflecting Antequera's historical defenses-; the ancient dolmens - ancient megalithic structures that serve as enduring monuments to prehistoric civilizations-; & the awe-inspiring collegiate - an architectural gem showcasing the city's religious heritage-. 

Enjoy the exclusivity & personalized experience of a private trip, allowing you to immerse yourself in the details of Antequera at your own pace.

items.n: Hiking - Cueva del Gato & Molino del Santo- 13km Moderate
items.d:
This popular walk takes us through beautiful Andalucian countryside, via a local beauty spot and on to finish at the renowned Molino del Santo hotel restaurant.

We leave Ronda down an old cobbled road beside the gorge and enjoy spectacular views up to the town on its clifftop plateau and the Puente Nuevo bridge. We then head out through open countryside towards the Guadiaro river and the Cueva del Gato or "Cat Cave", a local beauty spot named for the shape of the natural cave mouth. The mountain behind contains a network of water-filled tunnels and caverns. Each day thousands of litres of crystal clear water exit the cave via a waterfall to create a stunning, blue water pool.

We continue a short distance to the small village of Benaojan estacion and the Molino del Santo hotel, where we can relax on the terrace for optional refreshments before returning to Ronda in our minibus. Or choose to stay at the hotel for a delicious, leisurely lunch and return to Ronda by train or taxi.

Next, we'll head to Almáchar, we'll wander their quiet streets and, naturally, visit the Raisin Museum. Following this visit, we'll venture to El Borge. We'll explore the Moscatel Raisin Interpretation Center, witness vineyards firsthand, learn about raisin cultivation and taste some of these treats. Finally, we'll stroll through the streets of El Borge, adorned with numerous references to the raisins, which serves as the primary economic livelihood of the town. items.n: Self-Guided Modern Málaga: Two Centuries of Tragedy and Triumph
items.d:
Málaga has seen firsthand the dramatic upheaval that’s shaped Spain over the past 200 years. Once an industrial port, the city has blossomed into a modern cultural destination. On this walking tour, you’ll hear how three powerful industrialist families built their fortunes during the 1800s, only to see their empires crumble amid social and economic turmoil.

Starting on Paseo del Muelle Uno at the revamped cruise port, you’ll trace the rise and fall of the three dynasties who turned Málaga into Spain’s second-most important industrial centre. You’ll stroll along the elegant streets they financed and learn how riots, revolution, civil war and dictatorship transformed this Andalusian city. You’ll hear how ordinary Malagueños coped with economic collapse, brutal warfare, and Franco’s repression.

The tour ends at Santa Iglesia Catedral Basílica de la Encarnación de Málaga. You’ll learn how the impressive cathedral took 250 years to build, but only has one tower.

items.n: MTB (Self-Guided) - Bandits Trail - 45km Intermediate
items.d:
This circular route takes you along some of the old hillside trails and paths which ran between the secret caves and hiding places of Andalucia’s famous 19th century bandits. Back then, they used these “Rutas de los Bandoleros“ to evade the attentions of the authorities but the trails serve us better these days as superb cross-country mountain biking and hiking routes.

This ride begins with a climb from Ronda up high into the hills above the village of Arriate. You will pass bodegas (wineries) which produce some fine local wines and enjoy fantastic panoramas over the valley of the Serrania de Ronda. The Natural Parks of Sierra de Grazalema and Sierra de las Nieves are also visible on the horizon. We then drop down into the river valley to visit the picturesque village of Setenil de las Bodegas, with its unusual cave houses, where you can take a short refreshment break before returning up through open countryside and farmland to Ronda. Note: This route includes long ascents.

items.n: Tour at Malaga Fishing Scene with Cooking Workshop
items.d:
Malaga’s food scene is legendary, but it’s the seafood that truly sets it apart. On this guided tour, you’ll explore the rich maritime heritage behind the local cuisine. As Fernando, one of our expert guides, says, “Seafood is everywhere here, but not many tourists understand its cultural roots. This tour shows you a side of Malaga few get to see.”

After meeting your guide, you’ll walk along the scenic seafront to a traditional fishing neighborhood. There, you’ll learn about Malaga’s deep fishing traditions and meet local fishermen. You’ll also visit the Casa de Baños, a heritage site showcasing early 20th-century fishing methods.

Then it’s time to taste. You’ll watch a live demo of espetos, fish skewered on wooden sticks and roasted over an open beach fire. Finally, enjoy these coastal flavours as you dine by the water. It’s an authentic, delicious experience that goes beyond the typical tourist trail.

items.n: Nerja Day Tour from the Costa del Sol
items.d:
PANORAMIC FRIGILIANA:

Three hundred meters above sea level and with a subtropical microclimate, we find Frigiliana, noted for its lauded and award-winning Historic Center, of Moorish heritage, where narrow, winding and steep streets form a unique urban latticework of small houses. There we will have free time to walk its streets before leaving for Nerja.
PANORAMIC NERJA:

It has a long history proven by the paintings found in the Cave of Nerja, discovered in 1959, which could constitute the oldest rock art images in human history. Under Muslim rule, his name was Narixa, meaning “abundant source” and is the origin of the current name. Free time to tour its center and admire the Balcony of Europe, its Museum and its Multiple Churches.

Our expert guide will accompany you and give you the relevant directions to enjoy Frigiliana and Nerja, two beautiful villas of Moorish heritage.

items.n: Self-Guided Walk of Marbella: Moorish Medina to Luxury Resort
items.d: On this self-guided walking tour, you’ll explore the charming old town of Marbella. Once a humble fishing village, Marbella is now one of the most glamorous destinations on the Spanish coast. As you stroll along the sun-drenched Mediterranean promenade, past Renaissance townhouses, and Moorish remnants, you’ll find out how iron foundries and sugar estates positioned Marbella at the forefront of Spain’s industrialization in the 1800s. You’ll also see the interplay of cultures that left their imprint on Marbella’s architecture, cuisine, and character, from Phoenician traders and Muslim sultans, to Bourbon kings and Franco. The tour ends at the majestic Iglesia de Nuestra Señora de la Encarnación (Church of Our Lady of the Incarnation), where you’ll discover hidden depth beneath the city’s glamorous surface. By the end of this tour, you’ll have a new appreciation for how centuries of cultural exchange and reinvention have created this jewel of the Costa del Sol.

items.n: Tour and Drawing in Marbella. No previous experience

The tour combines walking, observation and painting, without haste and away from the format of a traditional guided tour. Share favorite places to paint and you will be helped to choose a simple and attractive frame for your watercolor. During the experience he will make two sketches, each focused on different environments: architecture, light, shade or everyday details.

It doesn’t matter if it’s your first time with watercolor or if you already have experience. The goal is not perfection, but to enjoy the creative process and bring you a personal experience of Marbella.

items.n: Marbella’s Old Town: A Self-Guided Walking Tour
items.d:
Marbella’s old town is a captivating maze where Moorish influences blend seamlessly with Andalusian charm.

On this self-guided walking tour, you’ll explore whitewashed buildings adorned with vibrant flowers and discover hidden plazas brimming with orange trees. As you walk, you’ll hear about this Mediterranean jewel’s fascinating history, from its Moorish castle to its transformation into a playground for the international jet set. You’ll also learn about Marbella’s unique microclimate and sealife.

You’ll weave through narrow streets lined with ceramic tiles depicting typical Spanish scenes, and make your way to the city’s main square, Plaza de los Naranjos, where orange trees have provided shade since the 1400s.

You’ll find out how mosques were transformed into churches after the Christian reconquest, learn why fountains were always built next to religious buildings, and hear other intriguing local legends.

items.n: Marbella Self-Guided Detective Murder Mystery Game
items.d:
Marbella becomes the crime scene in this self-guided detective game, where the clues are hidden in plain sight in the streets around you.

The case is the murder of Balthasar, and the evidence is scattered across the old centre - past Museo del Grabado Español Contemporáneo, Avenida del Mar, Iglesia de la Encarnacion and Parque de la Alameda. You decode messages, photograph what does not add up and press digital witnesses whose stories never quite line up.

Every puzzle you crack removes a name from the list of suspects. Play as a couple, bring the children along, or send two or three teams out at the same time and turn the investigation into a race - which is what makes this murder mystery game work as well for a team outing as for a day out. The last answer is waiting somewhere in the centre of Marbella.

Grazalema is, at its heart, a welcoming community steeped in centuries of tradition and culture. On this walking tour, you’ll stroll through cobblestone streets lined with whitewashed houses, each adorned with flowers. You’ll also learn about the village’s origins as a medieval Moorish settlement, its prominence during the Reconquista, and its Andalucian charm.

You’ll wander through the village’s vibrant streets, taking in iconic historical landmarks. You’ll learn about local Andalucian traditions and see both the lower and upper parts of the village, which once divided the wealthier residents from the working class.

On this tour, you’ll get a sense of this village’s enduring connection to its past and learn some of Grazalema’s gastronomic traditions.

items.n: Marbella Outdoor Escape Game: Self-Guided City Adventure
items.d:
Marbella itself becomes the puzzle in this self-guided outdoor escape game - no venue, no host, just your team and the streets.

Magnus has taken the formulas and scattered the proof across the old centre, past Plaza de los Naranjos, Capilla de San Juan de Dios, Plaza de África and Parque de la Alameda, and every location holds a code, a riddle or a photo task waiting to be cracked.

Roles matter here: one player reads, another looks, and the team moves on only once you agree. Send two or more teams out at the same time and the hunt becomes a contest, which is what makes this city escape game work as well for a team-building afternoon as for a day out with friends. Reading clues while the city moves around you is part of the challenge.

Visit the spectacular Cap Spartel, where the Atlantic Ocean meets the Mediterranean Sea, explore the legendary Hercules Caves, and enjoy a memorable camel ride along the Atlantic coast.
Continue into the heart of Tangier to wander through the historic Kasbah, the colorful Medina, and the lively souks filled with local crafts, spices, and traditional Moroccan products. Savor authentic Moroccan cuisine and refreshing mint tea while learning about the city's unique blend of African, Arab, and European influences.

A way of eating and lifestyle that is sunshine on a plate, enriches the soul and celebrates, local, fresh, seasonal produce, cooked and prepared simply and enjoyed in a relaxed manor, with family and friends.

items.n: From Marbella: Canyoning Adventure (Barranco de Zarzalones)
items.d:
Discover one of the most spectacular canyoning adventures in Andalusia – where you’ll rappel down waterfalls, jump into crystal-clear pools, slide along natural rock formations, and swim through water carved by an underground river. 

This tour involves around 3 to 4 hours inside the canyon, but the total activity lasts about 6 hours including transport. It is designed for adventurous beginners or anyone with a good level of fitness who wants to push themselves in nature. Participants should be between 16 and 55 years old, confident swimmers, and comfortable with heights and water jumps.

Your guided tour is led by an experienced, fully licensed English-speaking canyoning guide. All technical gear is included: wetsuit, helmet, harness, and ropes. We recommend bringing sport shoes with good grip, but canyoning shoes can also be provided if needed.

Our guides will capture the highlights of your day with GoPro® photos and videos, which you can download for free afterwards.

What stands out is the combination of premium comfort and unrivalled surroundings: relax watching the spectacular sunset over the Rock of Gibraltar and Africa, search for dolphins in their natural habitat and enjoy a last swim in crystal clear waters. All accompanied by cold drinks, snacks and paddle surfing, ideal for a romantic getaway or total disconnection at sea.

 - Premium private yacht sailing with capacity for small groups
 - Includes soft drinks, beer and snacks during the tour
 - Opportunity to swim and paddle surf in clear waters
 - Starting point in the Port of Estepona, with professional attention

items.n: Guided Beach Breathwork and Sea Meditation in Marbella
items.d:
Immerse yourself in a transformative journey of self-discovery on the serene shores of the Mediterranean.

Join David, who has guided over 30,000 people, in this intimate session offering a unique blend of breathwork and cold sea immersion designed to calm the mind, regulate the nervous system and rejuvenate the spirit!

We begin with a proper conversation about what brought you here and what you want from the session, so the practice is shaped around you - flowing into a tailored breathwork practice on the sand. Then, transition into a meditative sea immersion, where the cold water meets your breath, helping you to find peace and clarity. 

We'll conclude with drinks and a reflective debrief, ensuring you leave feeling lighter and more connected.

items.n: 2H Private Dolphin Trip With Drinks Included in Estepona
items.d:
Set sail on a private boat tour from Estepona Marina for an unforgettable adventure among dolphins. Cruise the stunning Costa del Sol as you search for playful dolphins, with breathtaking views of Estepona, Gibraltar, and even Morocco on clear days. Enjoy the Mediterranean waters with a swim stop, paddleboarding, or simply relax on a floating hammock. This exclusive experience is perfect for families, friends, or couples looking to create lasting memories by the sea.

- Duration: 2 hours of dolphin watching and swimming
- Private charter for up to 8 passengers
- Includes beverages, snacks, and paddleboarding
- Experienced local captain ensures a memorable journey

items.n: Podcast Tour Marbellas Empire of Umami
items.d:
Beneath the glitz of Marbella's Golden Mile and the mega-yachts of Puerto Banús lies a hidden empire built on salt, sun, and fermenting fish. Join historian Max and local expert Diana on a sensory journey back to the 1st century AD, when this coastline was the industrial engine of Roman Baetica. Discover how the pungent, umami-rich fish sauce known as 'garum' funded the extravagant patrician villas whose mosaics still survive today. This is a story of extreme luxury, invisible labor, and the ancient roots of modern coastal wealth.

-A 6.8 km self-guided tour with 6 stops over 164 min
- Ideal for travelers interested in History & Memory and Foodways & Culinary Identity
- Immersively told in a podcast style by experts and locals
- Matching audio content, AI guide and navigation through the app

items.n: Marbella Private Boat Charter 2hr
items.d: Escape the crowds and enjoy Marbella from the water on a private charter designed exclusively for your group. Cruise the coastline, swim in the Mediterranean, snorkel, relax with your favourite music and keep an eye out for dolphins. With a professional skipper, fuel included and flexible 2 to 8 hour experiences, every trip is tailored to create unforgettable memories at sea.
